items.title: Agenda de la semana: inflación en EE.UU. y Brasil, tasas en Perú y la COP31
items.author: Lizeth Ortega
items.summary: Bloomberg Línea — El dato de la inflación en Estados Unidos, así como el regreso del Congreso de ese país, serán algunos de los focos de los mercados esta semana, mientras en América Latina los ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — El dato de la inflación en Estados Unidos, así como el regreso del Congreso de ese país, serán algunos de los focos de los mercados esta semana, mientras en América Latina los inversores estarán atentos a los datos de inflación en Brasil, México, Colombia, y la decisión de tasas en Perú. En EE.UU., se prevé que la inflación general y subyacente de octubre muestren un menor ritmo de inflación intermensual. Cabe señalar que la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales no publicará las variaciones interanuales debido a que los datos de octubre de 2025 no se divulgaron durante el cierre del gobierno federal. Ver más: Los países de América Latina donde más aumentó la deuda externa en medio de un récord global A nivel mundial, la Conferencia de las Naciones Unidas sobre el Cambio Climático (COP31) en Antalya, Turquía, centrará la atención. El evento se extenderá hasta el 20 de noviembre. Además, las negociaciones mediadas por EE.UU. entre Rusia y Ucrania también serán importantes. De acuerdo con un análisis de Bloomberg Economics elaborado por los economistas Felipe Hernández y Adriana Dupita, junto con la analista Jimena Zúñiga, la semana estará cargada de datos económicos y decisiones de política monetaria importantes. En Brasil, se publicarán las minutas de la última reunión del Banco Central de Brasil, en las cuales se buscarán pistas sobre si el banco central contempla futuros ajustes tras mantener la tasa en 13,75%. Además, en este país también se conocerá la cifra de inflación. “La inflación brasileña volverá a superar el techo de la meta en octubre a pesar de algunos incrementos mensuales de precios más moderados”, mencionan los expertos. En Perú se conocerá la decisión de política monetaria del Banco Central de Reserva. Los analistas creen que se subiría la tasa de referencia en 25 puntos básicos al 4,50%, marcando así su primer incremento desde septiembre de 2025 para frenar el repunte de la inflación. En México, los especialistas esperan que la inflación anual haya subido al 3,6% en octubre, situándose aún por encima del punto medio del rango meta del banco central del 3%, con un margen de más o menos un punto porcentual. “Eso ubicaría el incremento de precios ligeramente por debajo del pronóstico del banco central del 3,7% para el promedio del cuarto trimestre”, señalan. Ver más: Una guía para invertir tras resultados de elecciones en EE.UU.: acciones, bonos, dólar y oro -Y para conocer las variables que orientan a los inversores, sigue la ruta de los mercados -Con información de Bloomberg Economics

items.title: US inflation set to cool in October after two months of sharp increases
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The consumer price index is seen rising 0.3% after a 0.6% increase that was the largest since April, based on the median projection in a Bloomberg survey of economists ahead of Tuesday's release ...
items.body: By Vince Golle and Craig Stirling Prices for US goods and services probably rose at a slower pace in October after two particularly uncomfortable months for American consumers. The consumer price index is seen rising 0.3% after a 0.6% increase that was the largest since April, based on the median projection in a Bloomberg survey of economists ahead of Tuesday’s Bureau of Labor Statistics’ release.  The core measure, which excludes often-volatile energy and food components, also probably cooled. The survey median sees a 0.2% increase for October, which would be the smallest advance in three months. The agency won’t publish year-over-year figures after it skipped the October 2025 CPI release due to the federal government shutdown at the time.   The October CPI will be the last before the Federal Reserve’s meeting in December, at which investors expect policymakers to boost interest rates. Economists will also assess the finer details of the report for clues on inflation risks into early 2027.  Economists at Citigroup Inc. said in a recent note that they anticipate limited pass-through of high energy costs to goods prices, as well as moderate services inflation.  What Bloomberg Economics Says... “We expect headline CPI slowed to 0.25% in October (vs. 0.65% prior). The core likely softened to 0.24% (vs. 0.33% prior), with both softer goods and services price gains driving the improvement. For goods, used cars and consumer electronics — categories that have faced pressure from the AI boom — saw slower inflation. For services, gains in owners’ equivalent rent are down a third from a September spike.” —Anna Wong, Troy Durie and Eliza Winger  The latest snapshot of inflation also follows Friday’s stronger-than-expected October jobs report. Sustained employment growth has the potential of ensuring consumers keep spending, while allowing the Fed to keep its focus squarely on inflation. Another price report, due on Friday, is projected to show nagging inflationary pressures faced by companies. The producer price index is forecast to accelerate to 6.6% for the year through October, the steepest annual increase in nearly four years. Aside from inflation reports, National Association of Realtors figures on Thursday are expected to show a decline in contract closings on previously owned homes to the lowest level since 2010 as mortgage rates stay elevated.  For more, read Bloomberg Economics’ full Week Ahead for the USIn Canada, September manufacturing and wholesale reports are expected to reflect a slowdown in third-quarter economic growth. Manufacturing sales likely rose just 0.1% that month, against 1.5% the month earlier.  That may be partly due to an unexpected work stoppage at US auto plants that dampened cross-border auto trade.  Wholesale sales, excluding petroleum, likely increased slightly, by 0.5%, against a 1.6% decline the month before. Meanwhile, the Bank of Canada will release a summary of the deliberations that led to its first rate hike in three years. Elsewhere, inflation data from China to Norway, central-bank minutes from Japan to Sweden, and growth data in the UK are among highlights. Asia The week kicked off with Australian housing data on Sunday, revealing that home sales and auction clearance rates climbed and offering hopes of a recovery for a property market that has slumped as interest rates rose this year. On Monday, inflation updates from China may show that consumer price gains slowed a tad in October, to 0.8%, as sectors outside energy and AI remain sluggish. Factory-gate inflation is seen accelerating to 5.4%, the fastest pace since June 2022, driven by supply-side reflationary pressure.   Japan also releases producer prices for October that will likely show cost pressures remain elevated, while consumer-price data from India may show inflation above 6% for the first time since August 2023. Third-quarter data from the Philippines are forecast to reveal economic growth accelerated a bit. Australia releases gauges for consumer and business sentiment on Wednesday, with the NAB Business Confidence reading for October likely to be negative for a ninth consecutive month.  New Zealand’s manufacturing PMI for October is due on Friday, with the gauge having stayed firmly in expansionary territory since July 2025.  September household spending data in Japan on Tuesday may show outlays fell for a 10th straight month, casting doubt over the Bank of Japan’s assertion that a virtuous cycle of rising incomes feeding into spending will gradually intensify. Trade data are due from China, India and Taiwan.  Asia has no central bank decisions in the coming week, but the BOJ will release a summary of opinions from its October board meeting. It held settings steady, while declaring that underlying inflation had finally reached its 2% inflation target. That assessment opens the door to another rate hike as soon as December. Europe, Middle East, Africa Third-quarter UK data on Thursday will illustrate the robust growth backdrop to the first rate hike there since 2023. Economists predict expansion quickened to 0.7%, which would be the strongest pace in more than two years.    Policymaker appearances will also draw attention. BOE Governor Andrew Bailey is in Zurich on Monday, and Deputy Governor Clare Lombardelli speaks at the “Bank of England and Its Watchers” conference the following day. European Central Bank chief economist Philip Lane also speaks at that event.  Meanwhile, following the close of nominations for ECB president, euro-zone finance ministers will discuss the race to succeed Christine Lagarde at a meeting in Brussels on Monday.  Data in the region include German exports on Monday, Italian industrial production on Wednesday, and a second reading of euro-area GDP on Friday. In the Nordics, Sweden’s Riksbank on Tuesday publishes minutes of its latest decision to raise borrowing costs. The same day, Norway’s inflation reading is due.   Egyptian officials will also closely watch their inflation reading on Tuesday after price growth eased for two straight months. The central bank unexpectedly raised rates in October. Ghana’s finance minister, Cassiel Ato Forson, in his 2027 budget to lawmakers on Thursday, is expected to outline details of a $10 billion economic plan aimed at accelerating growth and creating jobs after years of post-default fiscal consolidation. Russia’s economy is likely to show weak expansion when third-quarter data are published on Friday, according to Bloomberg Economics. Inflation numbers for October, also due on Friday, may show annual price growth accelerated to above 7% for the first time in a year. Latin America In Mexico, both full-month and late-month inflation data due on Monday look likely to push further above Banxico’s 3% target and ever closer to the 4% ceiling. The consensus sees readings just under the central bank’s new fourth-quarter forecasts, delivered with its surprising Nov. 5 quarter-point rate cut to 6.25%.  Colombia’s consumer-price report also comes on the heels of a rate-setting meeting, though in BanRep’s case the board opted to keep policy unchanged and at a much more restrictive 12.25%. Center stage on Tuesday belongs to Banco Central do Brasil, with Brazil-watchers hoping to glean some measure of guidance from the minutes of its Nov. 3-4 meeting. Few policy meetings have seen such a dramatic shift in outlook — from a strong consensus for a sixth straight cut to 13.5%, to the actual decision to hold the key Selic rate unchanged at 13.75%.  But President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s shock reelection and silence on how he plans to get the government’s finances back in order have sidelined the central bank for the time being. Prior to the bank’s Nov. 4 hold, local analysts had marked up their key rate forecasts to the 2029 forecast horizon. In a timely follow-up, Brazil’s October inflation figures are likely to show another move higher from September’s above-target 4.58% print, consistent with analysts’ most recent 2026 estimate of 5.22%. For Argentina, local analysts look for a third straight sub-2% monthly inflation print in October, potentially slower than September’s 1.9%, keeping the annual reading right around September’s 33.4% level.   Less than a year from the next election, Argentina’s economy has skidded into a technical recession and keeping the lid on consumer prices may be a challenge for President Javier Milei. Peru’s central bank meets Thursday, and after 13 straight months of keeping the key rate at 4.25%, Governor Julio Velarde and colleagues are likely to deliver their first hike since January 2023 after October inflation jumped to 5.25%.

items.title: Turkish villagers demand COP31 leaders see for themselves devastation caused by coal
items.author: The Straits Times
items.summary: IKIZKOY, Turkey, Nov 8 - Local official Nejla Isik is among the villagers living beside a coal mine who demand that world leaders gathering in Turkey for COP31 climate talks leave the conference venue to inspect the devastation decades of lignite extraction have caused.
items.body:
Turkish villagers demand COP31 leaders see for themselves devastation caused by coal
Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox

Published   Nov 08, 2026, 03:03 PM

Updated   Nov 08, 2026, 03:13 PM

Set as preferred source

Listen

IKIZKOY, Turkey, Nov 8 - Local official Nejla Isik is among the villagers living beside a coal mine who demand that world leaders gathering in Turkey for COP31 climate talks leave the conference venue to inspect the devastation decades of lignite extraction have caused.
Beginning on Monday, the transition to cleaner energy will be among the themes at the UN conference that continues until November 20 in Antalya on Turkey's Mediterranean coast.
Isik, an elected official for her community, says the government leaders and UN officials need to head a few hundred kilometres west to Ikizkoy, near the Akbelen forest in Turkey's southwestern Mugla province, and see for themselves the impact of coal on nature and on people's lives.

Villagers, who for years have protested against coal mining, have been fined and arrested.
"They should come here, those heads of state. They should come not to Antalya but to Akbelen, to Ikizkoy," said Isik. Her home in Ikizkoy is only a few hundred metres behind a lignite mine that has crept nearer over decades of expansion. Lignite is the lowest grade of coal, meaning burning it releases higher amounts of carbon dioxide than more energy-dense coal.
ELECTRIFICATION, BUT WILL IT BE GREEN?

So far one of the prominent aims of COP31 is to agree a voluntary goal on increasing electrification, proposed by host country Turkey, but unless the electricity is low-carbon it will not curb planet-warming emissions.
Last year, coal was Turkey's largest electricity source, generating 34% of the country's power, making Turkey Europe's biggest coal-fired electricity generator, according to energy think tank Ember. The mines in the Akbelen area provide coal for plants that generate just over 2% of Turkey's power, according to the operator's website.
Villagers and environmental campaigners like Isik, who oppose the expansion of lignite mining, say it has destroyed forest and threatens olive groves, farmland and communities.

The fight against coal has had harsh consequences. Isik's 26-year-old daughter Esra spent 42 days in pretrial detention after a protest against the planned expropriation of land for mining. A court in July sentenced her to two years in prison for resisting public officials. She is free pending the decision of an appeal.
"This punishment was not just handed to me. It was an attempt to punish everyone in this country who stands up for their rights, their land and their village," Esra Isik said.
Her mother has for years protested against the expansion of coal mining around her village.
“For 40 years we’ve been living with coal breathing down our necks. I try to live here with the breath of coal, with the dirt of coal,” Nejla Isik said.
The coal supplies the nearby Yenikoy and Kemerkoy power plants, operated by Yenikoy-Kemerkoy Energy, a joint venture involving Limak and IC Ictas.
Limak declined to comment for this story. IC Ictas did not respond to a request for comment.
At a meeting with foreign media on Thursday, Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said Turkey was working on a just transition to cleaner energy, but that it was difficult as the mines employ thousands of people.
He said nuclear energy offered the most viable alternative and Ankara was aiming for 10 gigawatts of nuclear generation capacity by 2040. That would equate roughly to current coal-powered production, according to Reuters calculations.
RESTRICTIONS ON PROTESTS IN TURKEY
Rights groups have raised concerns about restrictions on protests in Turkey, including blanket bans on demonstrations, mass detentions and what they say is the disproportionate use of force.
Human Rights Watch said in an October report that Turkish authorities had arbitrarily arrested and prosecuted environmental protesters in Akbelen and other parts of the country. It said security forces forcibly dispersed non-violent demonstrations and protesters, lawyers and journalists faced charges such as illegal assembly, obstructing public officials, trespass and spreading false information.
“With Turkey about to host the annual UN climate change summit, its environmental crackdown is a salient reminder of its intolerance of dissent,” said Deniz Bayram, assistant Europe and Central Asia researcher at Human Rights Watch.
The government says police intervene when demonstrations are unlawful or threaten public order. The interior ministry and justice ministry did not comment for this story.
The dispute around Akbelen intensified in 2023 when tree-felling resumed. Villagers say security forces used water cannon and pepper spray on demonstrators seeking to enter the forest and that other punishments followed.
“We were subjected to water cannon, pepper gas, detention, everything,” Nejla Isik said. “Afterwards, because we didn’t abandon this area, this village, there were fines, and a year later cases were opened against us.”
Hasan Yorulmaz, another resident, said protesters had marched to stop pine trees being cut down when soldiers blocked their path.
“They used pepper spray on women and men, young and old,” he said. “Despite that, we continued the resistance. I was at the front and they took me away and detained me.” REUTERS

Nov 8 : Luca Van Assche fell short in his bid to become the first French winner of the Paris Masters since 2008, but he will take plenty of positives from a strong run which ended in a semi-final defeat by world number four Ben Shelton.
Van Assche, ranked 47th in the world, pushed Shelton hard and took the first set in Saturday's semi-final, before eventually losing 5-7 6-3 6-4 to the American in front of home fans.
"It is true that this week is very important for me because I have a lot of high-level matches under my belt in a row. I played Shelton, who is number four in the world," the 22-year-old told reporters after his defeat.
"That showed everything that I could do well, where I have some room for progress. This will help me to have more self-confidence, I know now that I can reach a semi-final.

"I know that I can go toe-to-toe with a player like Shelton today. So there is a lot of positive things to get from this, and I will try to work more to be even better next year."
Van Assche's run in Paris means he will rise to a career-high ranking of 34th in the world when the latest rankings are published on Monday.
Asked if he was aiming to be among the seeded players at next year's Australian Open in January, he said: "I don't think I'm going to think along those lines.
"Of course it helps being a seeded player. I will be 34 in the ranking.
"It's a very good ranking. It's very positive. But above all, I will try to remain focused on my game, on learning new skills, on progressing, and then the ranking will follow."
Shelton will face seven-times Grand Slam champion Carlos Alcaraz of Spain in the Paris Masters final later on Sunday.

items.title: China’s Clean-Tech Manufacturing Boom Is Reshaping the Global Climate Fight
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: By Lewis Jackson, Valerie Volcovici and Simon Jessop China sent $132 billion in clean technology and investment to the developing world last year, by far the largest contribution to carbon-dioxide reduction of any country. In fact, the nation’s green-manufacturing juggernaut, built in part through heavy …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
By Lewis Jackson, Valerie Volcovici and Simon Jessop

China sent $132 billion in clean technology and investment to the developing world last year, by far the largest contribution to carbon-dioxide reduction of any country.

In fact, the nation’s green-manufacturing juggernaut, built in part through heavy subsidies from Beijing, nearly matches the current total of grants, loans and private finance that all wealthy countries sent to poorer ones in 2024 to help fight climate change, according to a Reuters analysis.

Those loans and grants stemmed from a climate-finance program the world’s wealthiest nations agreed to at a 2009 United Nations climate conference on the premise that industrialized nations made outsized contributions to the climate crisis – and had outsized means to help poorer countries pay to clean it up.

A Reuters investigation in 2024 found that most global climate finance comes in the form of loans – and sometimes at market interest rates that funnel billions of dollars back to rich countries.

China took a different approach, funneling billions in subsidies into its own green-energy industries, serving its own national interest to dominate next-generation manufacturing domestically and globally.

The result: massive and rapid market-share gains in solar panels, batteries and battery minerals, electric vehicles, wind turbines and other green products.

China remains by far the world’s biggest greenhouse-gas emitter because of its large population, concentration of heavy industry and reliance on coal power. But its huge clean tech exports mean it has also become among the biggest global forces in reducing climate-damaging emissions.

The Reuters analysis used customs data to calculate the value of Chinese exports of clean technologies to countries classified by the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development as developing nations.

Those exports alone will help the Global South avoid 257 million metric tons of carbon dioxide emissions (MtCO2) per year once deployed – an amount equal to the annual carbon dioxide emissions of France, according to analysis by Lauri Myllyvirta, co-founder of the Helsinki-based Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air. This year’s exports from China, meanwhile, are on track to avoid 337 MtCO2 in the Global South, the analysis shows.

Reuters was unable to find a reliable single estimate of how much greenhouse gas emissions are avoided as a result of global climate finance from rich to poor countries.

The OECD estimates a fifth of all rich world climate giving in 2024 came from the private sector.

The United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change and the High Ambition Coalition – an informal coalition of nations that has advocated for substantial climate finance – did not immediately comment for this story.

The $132 billion figure derived by Reuters for China’s global climate contribution also includes an estimated $40 billion of Chinese foreign direct investment into clean-technology projects in developing countries. The investment data was compiled by Mathias Larsen and Xiaokang Xue at the London School of Economics.

That brings China’s contribution to nearly equal to the $137 billion in climate finance that wealthy nations provided to poorer ones in 2024 under their UN climate pledges, according to the most recent figures provided by the OECD.

The figures are not directly comparable. China’s total largely reflects commercial transactions focused on clean energy development, while climate finance can also support other types of programs like developing climate-resilient agricultural techniques or cleaning up damage from major storms or floods.

But the comparison illustrates the extraordinary scale at which China’s manufacturing economy is now shaping the energy transition in poorer countries.

The findings point to a potential shift in the mechanics of the global energy transition, according to Li Shuo, a veteran observer of China at UN climate talks who heads the China Climate Hub at the Asia Society Policy Institute.

For years, climate talks focused on how much money and technology wealthy countries would provide to poorer ones to help them decarbonize. China’s manufacturing boom is creating another pathway: Driving down the price of clean technology through self-interested innovation and scale – until developing countries adopt it for economic reasons.

“You can align it to your economic agenda,” he said.

Export Giant, Diplomatic Mouse

Beijing has so far shown little interest in translating its commercial might into diplomatic leadership at global climate talks since President Donald Trump withdrew the United States from international climate cooperation in 2025.

China’s diplomatic role likely will take center stage as nations gather this month for the UN’s COP31 climate conference in Antalya, Turkey.

Bilateral agreements between heavyweights Washington and Beijing have traditionally paved the way for international climate agreements, including the landmark 2015 Paris deal to limit global warming. But Beijing may be unwilling to go on alone without its geopolitical counterweight at the table, according to former climate negotiators.

Beijing may also be worried that taking a bold stance on global carbon reduction would bring unwanted pressure for China to give more climate aid or cut its own fossil-fuel emissions, observers say. China emits about a third of all carbon dioxide emissions and still burns coal for more than half its power.

“How China engages on different levels in the coming years is the most fundamental thing that is going to happen on climate because of both their role in clean-tech deployment… but also because of their emissions profile,” said Jennifer Morgan, Germany’s former climate minister.

China’s Ministry of Commerce said the country is an important contributor to the global green transformation, and that its wind and solar exports have cumulatively reduced global emissions by roughly 4.1 billion tons of CO2 over the past five years – the equivalent of around 80% of the total emissions of the United States in one year.

“Against the backdrop of a global climate governance ‘action deficit,’ China will continue to uphold a responsible attitude, working with other countries to address challenges, overcome difficulties, and jointly promote global green and low-carbon transformation and sustainable development,” it said.

Forcing out Fossil Fuels

Meanwhile, China’s manufacturing boom has made renewable energy more affordable in the developing world.

When Ethiopia banned combustion engine car imports in 2024, for example, it was the first country to take such a dramatic step toward electric vehicles. The decision was less about emissions and more about cutting its fuel import bill, its deputy minister of transport at the time told Reuters.

“No one in Ethiopia is asking COP to pay for any of this; the economics have just switched. It is just the cheapest and best solution,” said Larsen, a senior policy fellow at the London School of Economics, who built the database of Chinese green investment used by Reuters in this story.

China has been by far the world’s biggest supplier of electric vehicles over the past few years, as dozens of subsidized automakers have waged a fierce price war in China and dramatically increased exports.

The green transition has been similarly pragmatic in Pakistan , which imported 17GW worth of solar from China last year, according to data from Ember, roughly on par with Germany’s installations that year. Those panels will cut emissions and, more importantly, provide cheap, reliable power in a country that often has neither.

Nearly two thirds of China’s exports of solar panels, and the cells needed to make them, went to the developing world last year, according to Reuters analysis of customs data.

The picture is different in wealthy countries like the United States and parts of Europe, which in recent years have imposed tariffs and other restrictions on Chinese clean technology to protect their domestic manufacturers from the surge in shipments.

The United States, for example, imposes tariffs exceeding 100% on Chinese electric vehicles and has taken other measures to effectively block them from the market.

“What is striking is that policies originally designed to address climate change are now facing opposition not because of their climate impacts, but because of concerns about trade and competitiveness,” said André Corrêa do Lago, a veteran climate negotiator for Brazil, which hosted last year’s climate summit.

Nov 8 : Usman Khawaja on Sunday denied that he had "thrown anyone under the bus", a day after an excerpt from the former Australian cricketer's autobiography claimed the entire team had been aware of ball-tampering during a 2018 tour of South Africa.
The scandal, dubbed "Sandpapergate" over Australia's scuffing of the ball with sandpaper in the March 2018 test in Cape Town, sparked a major integrity crisis for Cricket Australia.
However, only captain Steve Smith and batsmen David Warner and Cameron Bancroft, who was caught with the sandpaper in his pocket, were banned for their part in the scandal.
In a video posted on Instagram, Khawaja, who released the excerpt of his autobiography on Saturday, said he had wanted to "come clean" about the incident since 2018.

"I haven't thrown anyone under the bus," added the 39-year-old, who retired from international cricket in January.
"The guys that are currently in the team right now and the other people that were there on the South African tour, including me, we're not the victims.
"These three guys (Bancroft, Warner and Smith) took the blame for all of us, and they're the victims."
Khawaja said he had spoken with the three players involved in "Sandpapergate", and that he had promised Warner he would share his side of the story.
"These three guys deserve justice. And I haven't pointed fingers at anyone," he added.
"I'm still searching for what I was searching all those years ago for us — me included — to take the blame together as a team so we can all move on from this once and for all."
Australia's test side returned to South Africa for the first time since 2018 last month and were beaten 2-1 by the hosts in the three-match series, which was overshadowed in part by discussions of the scandal and the upcoming release of Khawaja's book.

items.title: Los temores inflacionarios resurgen y las empresas estadounidenses calculan el impacto en sus costos
items.author: Chloé Meley
items.summary: Las referencias a la inflación en las conferencias sobre resultados del S&P 500 han alcanzado su nivel más alto en más de dos años, lo que pone de manifiesto la creciente preocupación por el aumento v ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Las menciones a la inflación en las teleconferencias sobre resultados del S&P 500 han alcanzado el nivel más alto en más de dos años, lo que subraya la creciente preocupación por el vertiginoso aumento de los costes y el debilitamiento de la confianza del consumidor. Desde fabricantes de pintura hasta productores de especias, los directivos de las empresas han estado evaluando el impacto del aumento de los precios, buscando formas de aliviar la presión y tranquilizar a los inversores preocupados por las repercusiones en los márgenes. Los últimos datos sobre la renta y el gasto de los particulares “pintan un panorama preocupante para el consumidor estadounidense”, afirmaron los analistas de Bloomberg Economics Troy Durie y Anna Wong, ya que la inflación se está acelerando mientras que el crecimiento de los ingresos no logra seguirle el ritmo. La escalada de los precios del petróleo, que ha dado lugar a resultados espectaculares para las grandes empresas energéticas, ha impulsado al alza el precio del combustible, los fertilizantes, la resina plástica y otras materias primas clave, lo que encarece tanto el transporte aéreo como el embalaje de mercancías. En este contexto, las menciones a «inflación» o «inflacionario» ascendieron a 820 en las conferencias sobre resultados de las empresas del S&P 500 celebradas en octubre, la cifra mensual más alta desde febrero de 2024. Las empresas industriales representaron una cuarta parte del total de referencias, ya que los elevados costes energéticos y logísticos lastraron al sector. El fabricante de sistemas de climatización Lennox International Inc. registró el mayor número de menciones, y su director ejecutivo, Alok Maskara, advirtió de que la empresa prevé que “las presiones inflacionistas continúen, especialmente debido a los aranceles, los componentes y las materias primas”. Ver más: Los fabricantes de cerveza artesanal se ven afectados por el conflicto comercial entre EE. UU. y Canadá El sector de los materiales se ha visto afectado de manera similar, ya que los precios de los derivados del petróleo siguen subiendo. El fabricante de pinturas PPG Industries Inc. detalló sus planes para mitigar la presión mediante subidas de precios, aunque se mostró cauteloso a la hora de no exagerar los beneficios. “Desde luego, no daría por sentado que la inflación de los precios vaya a suponer un impulso favorable a corto plazo, ya que aún nos queda trabajo por hacer”, afirmó el director ejecutivo, Timothy M. Knavish, a lo que el director financiero, Jamie A. Beggs, añadió que los costes de las materias primas seguían al alza. Las empresas de consumo tampoco se han librado. General Motors Co., fabricante de los modelos Cadillac y Chevrolet, prevé este año un lastre de 2.000 millones de dólares debido al encarecimiento de las materias primas, la logística y los precios de la memoria, después de que la inflación supusiera unos 400 millones de dólares en costes adicionales en 2026. El fabricante de especias McCormick & Co. Inc. se enfrenta a unos elevados costes de transporte y a un gasto moderado. “De cara al año 2027, aún nos quedan muchas cuestiones por resolver en lo que respecta a la inflación y los costes, así como a la evolución del comportamiento de los consumidores”, afirmó el director ejecutivo, Brendan M. Foley, durante la conferencia sobre resultados. Incluso sectores que suelen estar mejor protegidos, como la banca, lo mencionan cada vez con mayor frecuencia. “La inflación y el aumento de los tipos de interés siguen siendo factores adversos, y cuanto más persistan, mayor será la presión que puedan ejercer tanto sobre los consumidores como sobre los clientes empresariales”, señaló el director ejecutivo de Wells Fargo & Co., Charles W. Scharf, en una conferencia con analistas. Ver más: Estados Unidos pone en marcha una iniciativa para interrumpir las rutas terrestres que utiliza Irán para transportar armas Dado que el coste de la vida es un tema central de las elecciones de mitad de legislatura en EE. UU., tanto los inversores como las empresas seguirán debatiendo sobre la escalada de los precios a medida que avance el resto de la temporada de presentación de resultados. Apenas una semana después del inicio del mes, las menciones a la inflación ya superan con creces el recuento total del pasado mes de noviembre. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: ｉｓｐａｃｅ、ＮＡＳＡの月面輸送で米法人が入札資格　直接提案可能に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Maki Shiraki

[東京 ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Maki Shiraki

[東京 ８日 ロイター] - 宇宙スタートアップのｉｓｐａｃｅ（アイスペース）は８日、米航空宇宙局（ＮＡＳＡ）の商業月面輸送サービスの新たなプログラム「ＣＬＰＳ２」において、米国法人（コロラド州デンバー）が主契約者として提案・入札に参加できる事業者の１社に選定されたと発表した。ＮＡＳＡが同日、同社を含む８社を公表した。

米国法人は今後、主契約者としてＮＡＳＡが個別に公募する月への物資輸送案件の入札に参加できるようになる。従来のプログラム「ＣＬＰＳ１．０」では同社は主契約者となる米国企業の下請けだったが、今回は主契約者として提案からミッション実施までを主導する立場となって受注獲得を目指す。

ＣＬＰＳ２は、ＮＡＳＡが将来の有人月面探査を見据え、月の南極に持続的な活動拠点を構える月面基地構想（ムーンベース計画）を支える商業輸送の新たな枠組み。科学、探査、技術実証、インフラ関連の物資を月面に輸送するサービスを米国の民間企業から調達する。契約上限額は基本発注期間の今後１０年間では１００億ドル（約１．５兆円）。

今回選ばれたのは同社米国法人のほか、スペースＸ、ブルーオリジン、ファイアフライ・エアロスペース、インテュイティブ・マシーンズ、ロッキード・マーチン・スペース、ノースロップ・グラマン・スペース・システムズ、ボイジャー・テクノロジーズの計８社。

受注が確定したわけではなく、案件ごとに入札を経る必要があるが、ｉｓｐａｃｅの袴田武史ＣＥＯ（最高経営責任者）は、ＮＡＳＡという大きな市場に「直接アクセスが可能なポジションを獲得した」と述べた。

同社はこれまで自社で２０２３年４月と２５年６月の２回、月面着陸に挑んだが、いずれも失敗している。同社は今回の選定について、２度の挑戦を通じて培った月面着陸に向けての技術開発力やミッション運用能力が「一定の評価を獲得したことを示すもの」（広報）としている。

EDINBURGH, Nov 8 : The New Zealand pair of Jordie Barrett and Will Jordan could miss next weekend's Nations Championship clash with Wales, after they picked up injuries at Murrayfield against Scotland on Saturday.
Jordan suffered a suspected hamstring injury in the second half of the All Blacks’ convincing 43-21 victory, while Barrett was taken off for a head injury assessment (HIA) which he failed. He had a clash with Scotland substitute Blair Kinghorn.
"Jordie failed his HIA, so it’s not sure whether he’ll be available this week, but we’ll get a bit of clarity later,” the All Blacks coach Dave Rennie said.
On Jordan, who is the All Blacks’ leading all-time try-scorer, the coach added: “He might have tweaked a hamstring. We’ll assess that, and I’m not sure of the severity of it.”

New Zealand are already without several key players, including inspirational loose forward Ardie Savea, for their four-match November programme in Britain, but had little problem shrugging off the Scottish challenge, even though their hosts were within three points at halftime.
“It was an ill-disciplined first half with a couple of yellow cards,” said Rennie of his team, who had both Wallace Sititi and Peter Lakai sent to the sin-bin. “You give Scotland opportunities near finish zone, they're going to hit you, but we were better in the second half. 
“We went to a contestable kick game to limit their time from a counterattack point of view, and were a lot more clinical, and we dominated territory a bit better.
“You just saw us lose our shape a couple of times, and from turnover we had two or three really gilt-edge opportunities that we spilt,” added the coach.

items.body:
［メキシコ市　７日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は７日、各地で試合を行い、ナゲッツはメキシコ市でペーサーズに１１４─１０２で勝利した。

ナゲッツのニコラ・ヨキッチが１９得点、１３リバウンド、８アシストと活躍。キャメロン・ジョンソンが１８得点、ジャマール・マレーが１６得点、８アシストをマークした。

ＮＢＡがメキシコで試合を行ったのは３５回目（プレシーズン１９試合、レギュラーシーズン１６試合）だった。

PARIS, Nov 8 : France's Tom Laperche clinched victory in the Route du Rhum's Ultim class in his first appearance, mastering a transatlantic race that knocked out three rival boats.
The 29-year-old skipper crossed the finish line in Pointe-a-Pitre at 10:31 p.m. on Saturday (0231 GMT on Sunday) aboard SVR-Lazartigue, completing the 3,542-nautical-mile race from Saint-Malo to Guadeloupe in 6 days, 13 hours, 27 minutes and 40 seconds.
He set a race record, beating Charles Caudrelier's 2022 mark of 6 days, 19 hours, 47 minutes and 25 seconds.
"I've always seen incredible images of finishes here, of great champions over the decades," Laperche said after his victory.

"My dream, first of all, was to one day sail these boats, perhaps to do some solo sailing, and why not race the Route du Rhum? So to win it at the helm of the most beautiful of the boats in the 2026 edition makes me very, very happy."
Laperche, who won the Fastnet Race and the Transat Cafe L'Or last year, was locked in an intense battle with Armel Le Cleac'h in the early part of the race. But the skipper of Maxi Banque Populaire XI eventually capsized off the Azores on Wednesday morning, three days after the start.
Le Cleac'h, winner of the 2016-17 Vendee Globe, was rescued by a Panamanian cargo ship.
He was not the only one to abandon in the Ultim class, whose trimarans are 32 metres long and 23 metres wide (105 feet by 75 feet). Defending champion Charles Caudrelier was forced out on Tuesday due to foil damage on his new Maxi Edmond de Rothschild — Gitana 18.
Anthony Marchand, skipper of Actual Ultim 4, also dropped out of the transatlantic race on Wednesday, two days after suffering a major technical problem with his central rudder.
The retirements left the way clear for Laperche, one of the most talented skippers of his generation, who has been mentored by 2012-13 Vendee Globe winner François Gabart.
The Ultims were the first boats to finish. The IMOCAs — 60-foot (18-metre) monohulls used in the Vendee Globe and the Ocean Race — are expected to reach Guadeloupe on Tuesday, with MACSF skipper Corentin Horeau leading the fleet.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　７日　ロイター］ - 女子テニスの世界ランキング１位、エレーナ・ルバキナ（カザフスタン）が７日、体調の問題を理由にＷＴＡファイナルを欠場すると表明した。

ルバキナは声明で「素晴らしいシーズンを過ごしてきたが、体調の面で試合に臨める状態ではない。自宅でしばらく休養と回復に努め、来シーズンに向けて準備を整えたい」とコメントした。

ルバキナは８月のシンシナティ・オープン（ＯＰ）で脚を負傷し、イガ・シフィオンテク（ポーランド）との準々決勝を途中棄権。それでも全米ＯＰまでに復帰すると自身３度目となる四大大会優勝を達成し、ＷＴＡファイナル出場を最初に決めていた。

その後、武漢ＯＰは脚のけがで欠場し、東レ・パンパシフィックＯＰは首を痛めて準々決勝を棄権した。

ＷＴＡファイナルにはマルタ・コスチュク（ウクライナ）がルバキナに代わって出場する。

NEW YORK, Nov 7 : Inter Miami's Lionel Messi became the first to win MLS' Golden Boot in back-to-back seasons, the league said on Saturday, the final day of the regular season.
• Messi scored a league-high 26 goals across 31 matches, while FC Dallas forward Petar Musa followed with 22 goals and Nashville SC's Sam Surridge recorded 21.
• He had 29 goals the previous season, becoming the second in league history to score at least 25 times in back-to-back years.
• The 39-year-old Argentine retired from international football earlier this year after 21 years but signed a contract extension with the MLS club through 2028 in October.
• The MLS Cup Playoffs begin on November 19. Inter Miami finished the regular season second in the Eastern Conference.

MEXICO CITY, Nov 7 : Nikola Jokic did not need a triple-double to win over Mexico City, just 19 points, 13 rebounds and an arena chanting "MVP."
The three-time NBA Most Valuable Player added eight assists as the Nuggets held off a second-half surge from Indiana to win 114-102 on Saturday before a sellout crowd of more than 20,000 at Arena CDMX.
"It was a really good crowd. The energy was there the whole game. I didn't know who they were cheering or if it was just for us, but the energy was the most important thing," Jokic told reporters.
The game, played during Day of the Dead week for the third consecutive year, was packed with Pacers yellow jerseys, yet much of the noise seemed to be for the Serbian center.

"I think basketball is a global sport, and I think it's really good to travel as a team all over the world. I think it's really nice to see the love from the fans that are supporting us... Mexican people are really emotional, really passionate about whatever they're doing," Jokic said.
Before tip-off, Nuggets forward Aaron Gordon addressed the crowd in Spanish: "Vamos Nuggets. Viva Mexico."
It was the first Mexico City appearance for either team. The Pacers had never played in Mexico, and the Nuggets had appeared in the country once, a 2006 pre-season game against Golden State in Monterrey.
It was the 35th NBA game played in Mexico, including 16 regular-season and 19 pre-season games.
The Pacers were without All-Star guard Tyrese Haliburton, who missed the trip with a hamstring strain, blunting a game marketed around him and Jokic.
Denver controlled most of the first half, building a lead of as many as 27 on the way to a 64-41 halftime edge.
Indiana roared back with a 37-point third quarter and pulled within 102-95 with 7:27 left, but Denver answered. Jamal Murray found a cutting Spencer Jones under the basket, and the Nuggets restored a double-digit cushion.
Cameron Johnson added 18 points and Murray had 16 points and eight assists for Denver. Jones, making his season debut after missing the first seven games with a hamstring injury, scored 13 off the bench.
Pascal Siakam led Indiana with 23 points and Larry Nance Jr. added 15, tying a career best with five 3-pointers.
Former NBA players Danilo Galliari, Nene Hilario, Greivis Vasquez and Horacio Llamas, the first Mexican-born player in the NBA, were recognized between quarters.
Denver improved to 5-3, while Indiana fell to 3-7. The Nuggets play at Houston on Monday night.

［マインツ（ドイツ）　７日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは７日、各地で試合を行い、伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘンが佐野海舟フル出場のマインツに２─１で勝利し、首位をキープした。

バイエルンは前半１４分にヨシュア・キミヒ、後半１２分にレナート・カールがいずれもハリー・ケーンのお膳立てから決め、相手の反撃を同アディショナルタイム３分の１点に抑えた。

この試合ではバイエルンのＧＫマヌエル・ノイアーが４０歳２２５日でピッチに立ち、ベルント・ドレーアーを抜いてクラブ史上最年長での出場を果たした。しかし足のけがが再発したとみられ、前半終了間際に交代した。伊藤は後半４１分からピッチに入った。マインツの川崎颯太はベンチ入りするも出番はなかった。

堂安律が先発したアイントラハト・フランクフルトはパーダーボルンと２─２で引き分けた。堂安は後半１９分までプレーした。同僚の小杉啓太はベンチ入りしなかった。

その他、ドルトムントはエルファースベルクに２─１で勝利し、ライプチヒはアウクスブルクに５─２と大勝。シュツットガルトはブレーメンを１─０で下した。

９試合を終えて、バイエルンは勝ち点２１。同勝ち点のドルトムントは得失点差により２位とし、ライプチヒは暫定３位に浮上した。

items.title: トランプ氏、総合格闘技ＵＦＣのトップに大統領報道官就任を依頼
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は７日、総合格闘技のプロモーターであるダナ・ホワイト氏にホワイトハウスの報道官への就任を依頼したと発表した。

ＵＦＣ（アルティメット・ファイティング・チャンピオンシップ）の最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）であるホワイト氏について、トランプ氏は「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「凶暴なファイターであり戦士だ」と評した。

また「中にはわが国出身ではない者もいるが」とした上で、アシスタントとして、ロシア出身者も含め数人の格闘家を連れてくるよう求め「我々は、狂った左翼から身を守るために、こうした人々を必要としている」と述べた。

items.title: Ｆ１＝ブラジルＧＰ予選、ノリスが3年連続のＰＰ獲得
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［サンパウロ　７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［サンパウロ　７日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の今季第２０戦、ブラジル・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は７日、サンパウロで予選を行い、ランド・ノリス（英国、マクラーレン）が同ＧＰでは３年連続のポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

予選は大雨により、約１時間半にわたり中断。ノリスは「どんな形でもＰＰを獲得することが重要だった。それができてとても満足している」と述べた。

ジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）が２番手だったが、エンジン交換で５グリッド降格のペナルティーを受ける。先週末、史上最年少での個人総合優勝を決めたキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）が３番手から繰り上がる。

シャルル・ルクレール（モナコ、フェラーリ）が４番手、リアム・ローソン（ニュージーランド、レーシングブルズ）が５番手、ニコ・ヒュルケンベルグ（ドイツ、アウディ）が６番手だった

ルクレールがパワーユニット変更により１０グリッド降格のペナルティーを受けるため、決勝でローソンは３番手、ヒュルケンベルグは４番手からスタートする。

items.title: サッカー＝田中先発のリーズ、リーグ戦6試合ぶりの勝利
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ロンドン　７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ロンドン　７日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは７日、各地で試合を行い、田中碧が先発したリーズはトットナムを１─０で下した。

リーズは後半３４分、途中出場のノア・オカフォーが得点。これが決勝ゴールとなった。田中は後半３２分までプレーした。リーズはリーグ戦で６試合ぶりの勝利を挙げて、暫定８位に浮上した。

守田英正が所属するハルは昨季王者アーセナルに０─１で敗戦。後半にアーセナルの主将マルティン・ウーデゴールに決勝ゴールを決められた。守田はベンチ入りしなかった

マンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）はノッティンガム・フォレストに１─３で敗れ、３連敗。フラムとニューカッスルは１─１で引き分けた。

１０試合を終えて、アーセナルが勝ち点２７の首位で、マンＣは６差の暫定２位。ノッティンガム・フォレストは勝ち点９の暫定１６位に浮上した。

items.title: サッカー＝バレンシアはレアルに完敗、佐藤龍之介はベンチ外
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［７日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［７日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのスペイン１部は７日、各地で試合を行い、佐藤龍之介が所属するバレンシアはレアル・マドリードに０─３の完敗を喫した。佐藤はベンチ外だった。

バレンシアは前半２８分にフェデリコ・バルベルデにゴールを許すと、同３６分にもアルダ・ギュレルに決められる。後半３０分にはギュレルのアシストからキリアン・エムバペに加点されると、その５分後に主将のホセ・ガヤがエムバペに激しいタックルを見舞って一発退場に。数的不利に陥ると最後までネットを揺らせず、今季７敗目を喫した。

その他、ラシンはマラガに２─１で勝利し、エスパニョールとデポルティボはスコアレスドロー。オサスナはビルバオと１─１で引き分けた。

１２試合を終え、レアルは翌日に試合を控える首位バルセロナと同じ勝ち点３０とした。ハビエル・アギーレ監督率いるバレンシアはここまでわずか２勝で同９の１９位に低迷。今季はまだホームで勝利がない。

items.author: CNA

FAST

Nov 7 : Elena Rybakina's withdrawal from the WTA Finals on the eve of the season-ending championships is disappointing, but the world number one needs time to recover from the physical toll of a demanding year, tournament director Garbine Muguruza said.
Defending champion Rybakina pulled out of the tournament on Saturday, saying she was not physically ready to compete, leaving Ukraine's Marta Kostyuk to take her place in the eight-player field at Indian Wells. Tournament organizers later said a viral illness was the official reason for the withdrawal.   
Muguruza, the former world number one and two-time Grand Slam champion, said she had spoken with Rybakina and that the Kazakh had been unable to recover in time after struggling with physical problems late in the season.
"We love Elena and we know that she was feeling so-so in Tokyo as well," Muguruza told Reuters. "I spoke to her today and she really couldn't recover on time.

"What we want is for her to feel good, to go rest, to recover. We don't want her to feel like she has to play — only if she's ready to."
Rybakina, who won two Grand Slam titles this year, also withdrew from the Tokyo quarter-finals last month because of a neck injury.
'AMAZING FIELD'
Rybakina's absence deprives the event of some star power, but Muguruza said the round-robin format and depth of the field would ensure a high-quality tournament.
"We have the best players," said Muguruza, who triumphed at the WTA Finals in Guadalajara in 2021. 
"I know our world number one is not going to be able to play, but we have an amazing field, the very best.
"Every match could be a Grand Slam final. You really need to be ready. You cannot give one inch."
Kostyuk, who is making her WTA Finals debut after a breakthrough season that included the Madrid title and a rise into the top 10, was already in Indian Wells as an alternate and practicing when Rybakina withdrew.
Muguruza said the Ukrainian, known for her signature post-match backflip celebrations, had earned her opportunity.
"Marta is great. She's had a breakthrough year," Muguruza said. "With this year, we have many first-time players in the Finals, and that's very exciting. It's very hard to qualify."
Kostyuk has been outspoken about Russia's invasion of Ukraine and does not shake hands with Russian or Belarusian opponents. Muguruza said the tournament would support players in making their own decisions.
"They're free to do whatever they feel," she said. "We are open and supporting them."
OPPORTUNITY FOR SABALENKA 
Rybakina's withdrawal could create an opening for world number two Aryna Sabalenka to make inroads in the rankings. 
Sabalenka, who won the Indian Wells title earlier this year, has the chance to reduce the gap with Rybakina at the top of the rankings, Muguruza said, while also highlighting Russian teenager Mirra Andreeva as a player comfortable in the California desert.
"Of course, Aryna might be thinking that this can be a good opportunity," Muguruza said.
The WTA moved the Finals to Indian Wells from Riyadh, with Muguruza saying player safety had been the decisive consideration amid conflict in the region.
"It clearly felt no longer safe to be in a region where there is conflict," she said. "Taking care of the players and looking ahead to what could be safe, comfortable and secure, relocating felt the best decision."
Muguruza said players had responded positively to the switch to Indian Wells, where she competed regularly during her career.
"When we knew that Indian Wells could be the next venue, it was just a joy," she said, adding that ticket sales have been strong. "The whole thing is just perfect."

Source: Reuters

items.author: CNA

FAST

SAO PAULO, Nov 7 : Ferrari teammates Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc said they had put last weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix controversy behind them after holding talks aimed at easing tensions following their opening-lap clash.
The pair met with team principal Frederic Vasseur this week after their battle derailed Ferrari's hopes of a one-two finish and prompted Hamilton to publicly criticise the way the race unfolded.
Vasseur said on Friday that the discussions had been productive and that Ferrari had "turned the page", while Hamilton had insisted earlier in the week that he would not apologise for speaking openly about his frustrations.
After qualifying for the Sao Paulo Grand Prix on Saturday, both drivers struck a conciliatory tone and said the matter was now closed.

"From my perspective, I was very straightforward, of course, and I think it was good to speak," Leclerc told reporters at Interlagos about the incident which he felt had been blown out of proportion.
The Monegasque, who became a father this week, said the timing of the discussions had been affected by personal commitments but that talking face-to-face had helped resolve the issue.
"Now I consider that a closed chapter, and I think it will be important to look ahead," he said.
Hamilton echoed that view, saying the conversation had allowed both drivers to air their perspectives before moving on.
"We sat and spoke and we squashed it and we're moving on," the seven-times world champion said.
"I think we still have a huge amount of respect for each other. I'm glad we had a chat and now we move on. We've been getting along just fine as normal."
The Briton added that neither side had made demands during the talks and that the focus had been on working together more effectively.
Leclerc was fourth fastest in qualifying but will drop 10 places on the grid for Sunday's race because of power unit changes, while Hamilton will start from the back after accumulating engine penalties totalling 65 places, prompting Ferrari to stop his participation after the first phase of qualifying.

MANCHESTER, Nov 7 : Britain's Willy Hutchinson beat compatriot Joshua Buatsi by unanimous decision on Saturday to take the vacant WBC light-heavyweight belt.
• The judges scored the fight at Manchester's AO Arena 117-112, 115-113, 115-113 as Hutchinson avenged a 2024 loss to the 2016 Olympic bronze medallist when they fought on the undercard of Daniel Dubois' IBF heavyweight defence against Anthony Joshua at Wembley.
• Undefeated American David Benavidez gave up the belt last month to continue his career as a cruiserweight.
• Russia's WBA, WBO, IBF and Ring Magazine light-heavyweight world champion Dmitry Bivol is due to defend his titles against Britain's Callum Smith in Yekaterinburg on December 12.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ラグビー＝日本はウェールズに敗戦、ネーションズ選手権
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［カーディフ　７日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［カーディフ　７日　ロイター］　 - ラグビーの強豪１２カ国・地域で争う国際大会、ネーションズ選手権は７日、英国のカーディフなどで試合を行い、世界ランキング１２位の日本代表は同１０位のウェールズ代表に２１─２８で敗れた。

日本はベン・ガンターとワーナー・ディアンズがトライを決めたが、前半を１４─２１で終了。後半に１４点差とされた後、福田健太がトライを奪ったものの、追い付くことはできなかった。

日本はボール保持率６２％と相手を上回ったが、１勝３敗に。ウェールズは２勝２敗となった。ウェールズは２０２３年ワールドカップ以降、１８連敗を喫したが、直近５戦のテストマッチで３勝目とした。

日本は１４日、イングランドと対戦する。

SAO PAULO, Nov 7 : Brazilian drivers endured a torrid, rain-hit qualifying session for the Sao Paulo Grand Prix on Saturday as Gabriel Bortoleto finished last and F1 debutant Rafael Camara qualified 13th, dampening the excitement surrounding Brazil's first home driver pairing at Interlagos in a decade.
Audi's Bortoleto slid into the barriers in Q1, reviving memories of last year's nightmare when he retired on the opening lap of his first home Grand Prix after an earlier sprint crash.
"Right now, (it feels like) shit. I mean,. what can I say? Last year, I had a crash. This year, I couldn't do qualifying properly because I messed up.
"So yeah, it looks like home race for me hasn't been good yet," Bortoleto told reporters, adding he would clear his head and try to put together a strong performance on Sunday.

Camara, making his Formula One debut for Haas after replacing Frenchman Esteban Ocon, spun in Q1 and recovered, only to lose control later in the session and hit the wall.
Camara described it as a chaotic qualifying session but played down the incident, saying the support from the home crowd helped him keep a positive mindset despite the setback.
"I think it’s another learning experience for tomorrow. Of course, it’s not ideal, but you end up understanding more and preparing yourself much better."
Both Brazilians gained places on the grid after qualifying, as penalties reshuffled the starting order.
Max Verstappen, Sergio Perez and Lewis Hamilton were already set to start from the back after taking additional power unit components, promoting Bortoleto to 19th.
Charles Leclerc, who qualified ahead of Camara, will also drop behind the Brazilian due to a penalty, leaving the Haas driver set to start 11th.

items.title: フィギュア＝ＧＰ第3戦の中国杯、女子では千葉百音が優勝
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［７日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第３戦、中国杯は７日、深センで競技を行い、女子では千葉百音が優勝した。

ショートプログラム（ＳＰ）首位の千葉はこの日のフリーで２位となり、合計２２４．４８点でＧＰ３勝目を挙げた。今季ＧＰシリーズでは日本勢が３連勝。第１戦では中井亜美、第２戦では島田麻央が優勝していた。

ロシアから個人の中立選手（ＡＩＮ）として出場したアレクサンドラ・イグナトワがフリーで１位となり、合計２２１．２７点で２位。李海仁（韓国）が合計２１０．７９点で３位に入った。

山下真瑚は合計１９３．３２点で６位。渡辺倫果は合計１５４．８６点で１１位に終わった。

ペアではＳＰ４位の長岡柚奈、森口澄士組がフリーでは３位となり、合計１８１．５０点で３位。ＧＰ初の表彰台を獲得した。

items.title: ゴルフ＝ＴＯＴＯジャパンクラシック、岩井明が単独首位で最終日へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［７日　ロイター］ - 女子ゴルフで日米の両ツアーを兼ねるＴＯＴＯジャパンクラシックは７日、茨城県の太平洋クラブ美野里（パー７２）で第３ラウンドを行い、ＬＰＧＡツアー２勝目を目指す岩井明愛が単独トップに立った。

５位でスタートした岩井は６バーディー、ノーボギーの６アンダー６６でラウンド。通算１５アンダーの２０１に伸ばした。この日のベストスコア、６５をマークしたアルピチャヤ・ユボン（タイ）が１打差の２位。原英莉花と黄裕敏（韓国）が首位と２打差の３位につけた。

昨年覇者の畑岡奈紗、荒木優奈、佐久間朱莉、高橋彩華が通算１２アンダーの５位。２週連続優勝を狙う山下美夢有、勝みなみ、河本結ら６人が通算１０アンダーの９位で並んだ。

神谷そらは通算９アンダーの１５位。３位で出た菅楓華は２オーバー７４とスコアを伸ばせず、通算８アンダーの１９位に後退した。

items.title: Analistas de Wall Street consideran que la caída de la bolsa es un nuevo motivo para comprar
items.author: Emily Forgash
items.summary: Numerosos analistas de Wall Street contaban con que, tras las elecciones de mitad de legislatura de EE. UU., se produjera una ola de ventas a corto plazo que ofreciera a los inversores la oportunidad ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Numerosos estrategas de Wall Street apostaban por una venta masiva a corto plazo tras las elecciones de mitad de mandato en Estados Unidos para brindar a los inversores la oportunidad de comprar acciones con descuento. El jueves, obtuvieron mucho más de lo que esperaban. Y ahora instan a sus clientes a aprovechar la situación. “Este es el momento en el que debería aumentar su exposición al riesgo durante las próximas dos o tres semanas”, afirmó Mike Wilson, estratega jefe de renta variable estadounidense de Morgan Stanley. Wilson se mostró tan sorprendido como el resto ante la intensidad de las ventas del jueves, que provocaron una caída del 4,4 % en el índice S&P 500 y un desplome del 6,4 % en el índice Nasdaq 100, debido a la preocupación de que los demócratas, recién reforzados en el poder, frenen el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial. Aun así, Wilson confía en que las acciones estadounidenses están preparadas para un repunte, y se mantiene firme en su objetivo de que el S&P 500 alcance los 8.000 puntos a finales de año, lo que implicaría una subida del 8,4 % respecto al cierre del viernes. Los inversores volvieron a entrar en el mercado el viernes, lo que hizo que el S&P 500 subiera un 0,3 %. No obstante, el índice de referencia sigue registrando una caída del 2,5 % desde que se cerraron las urnas el martes. Los demócratas obtuvieron el control del Senado y de la Cámara de Representantes, así como de numerosas asambleas estatales y gobernaciones en todo el país. Muchos de los candidatos ganadores se comprometieron a frenar el desarrollo de centros de datos y a aumentar la regulación. Esta caída es una prueba de que la ola de ventas en el S&P 500 de las últimas semanas está llegando a su fin, y no una señal de que el sector de la IA se esté derrumbando, lo que indicaría más dificultades por delante, argumentan Wilson y muchos de sus colegas de Wall Street. “Hemos tenido una burbuja de la IA y creo que esa burbuja se está desinflando”, afirmó Ed Yardeni, estratega jefe de inversiones de Yardeni Research, en una entrevista el jueves. “Su estallido supondría importantes repercusiones negativas para la economía, y no veo que eso vaya a suceder”. Wilson recomienda a los inversores que adquieran acciones de empresas orientadas al consumo, sobre todo si los tipos de interés y los precios del petróleo siguen bajando, mientras que a Yardeni le atraen los valores del sector sanitario. “Lo considero una corrección”, afirmó Yardeni, cuyo objetivo para el S&P 500 a finales de año es de 7.900 puntos. “Preveía oportunidades de compra tras las elecciones, y creo que estamos empezando a ver algunas bastante buenas”. Muchas mesas de negociación de Wall Street se vieron sorprendidas por la caída del jueves, tras haber aconsejado a sus clientes que volvieran a invertir en el mercado tras las elecciones. El S&P 500 subió un 1,6 % el miércoles, ya que los inversores acogieron inicialmente con entusiasmo los resultados. Ver más: Acciones de Latam viven su mejor semana en Wall Street: analistas ven potencial de alza del 54% “Existe un margen considerable para que los inversores vuelvan a asumir riesgo”, escribió Scott Rubner, responsable de estrategia de renta variable y derivados sobre acciones, en una nota a sus clientes el miércoles. “A medida que la incertidumbre se disipa y regresan varios de los mayores compradores del mercado, creemos que la trayectoria de menor resistencia para la renta variable estadounidense es al alza de cara a finales de año”. Sin embargo, al cierre de la sesión del jueves, el S&P 500 había perdido 3 billones de dólares en valor de mercado. Aun así, la mayoría de los estrategas no se desaniman. El objetivo medio de fin de año para el índice de referencia es de 7.973, según datos recopilados por Bloomberg. “Sería imprudente abandonar el mercado tras haber experimentado un ligero ajuste en respuesta al resultado de las elecciones”, afirmó Jonathan Golub, estratega jefe de renta variable de Seaport Global Holdings, quien prevé que el S&P 500 cierre el año en 8.200. “Soy un comprador rotundo”. Un obstáculo importante para el repunte del S&P 500 sería la continua debilidad del sector de la inteligencia artificial, que ha impulsado al alza el índice de referencia durante la mayor parte de este mercado alcista que ya lleva cuatro años. El índice de semiconductores de la Bolsa de Filadelfia se desplomó un 12 % el jueves y sigue registrando una caída del 36 % respecto al máximo alcanzado en junio. “El sector de los semiconductores y el de las infraestructuras de IA, que realmente han impulsado el mercado en lo que va de año, seguirán bajo presión”, afirmó Ohsung Kwon, estratega jefe de renta variable de Wells Fargo. “Para que el mercado suba mucho más a partir de ahora, se necesita esa contribución del sector de alta beta”. Ver más: Los fabricantes de cerveza artesanal se ven afectados por el conflicto comercial entre EE. UU. y Canadá Sin embargo, si persisten los temores sobre un retroceso en la expansión de la inteligencia artificial, es probable que gigantes tecnológicos como Alphabet Inc. y Amazon.com Inc. —que han inquietado a los inversores al invertir masivamente en esta tecnología— proporcionen cierto apoyo alcista ante las expectativas de que se vean obligados a recortar el gasto, según Kwon, quien tiene un objetivo de 7.700. “No queremos mostrarnos demasiado pesimistas en este sentido”, afirmó. items.body:

Russell rages after aborted lap in fight for pole

Formula One F1 - Sao Paulo Grand Prix - Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace, Sao Paulo, Brazil - November 7, 2026 Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and George Russell during qualifying before the pit exit was closed due to heavy rain REUTERS/Adriano Machado

SAO PAULO, Nov 7 : George Russell raged over the radio after the Mercedes driver was thwarted in a bid for a morale-boosting fastest lap in Sao Paulo Grand Prix qualifying on Saturday.
Russell carried a five-place grid penalty for an engine change but the Briton still wanted to finish the session on top.
Instead, he was told to back off after coming up behind Williams' Alex Albon and the rain then denied him any further chance of beating the pole time set by McLaren's Lando Norris.
"Mate, you told me to back off! What the hell?," Russell shouted over the radio after realising his day was done and he was only second fastest and would be seventh on the grid. "P2. I don't want to be P2. I want to be P1."

Team boss Toto Wolff said it was a 50-50 call and Russell, after so many ups and downs this season, had been in league of his own.
"I don't think it would have been enough for pole, but he drove perfectly all session and merited to be on pole," said the Austrian of the aborted lap.
"He deserved it but you can't make that call. It's 50 per cent right or wrong.
Russell's teammate Kimi Antonelli clinched the title at the previous race in Mexico City and the Briton is now fourth in the battle for overall runner-up after starting the season as title favourite.
"That was definitely the pole lap," the 28-year-old said later. "Misjudgement on our side. Need to understand what happened as obviously the rain was coming and we should have just finished the lap.
"It depends on the weather," he said of his prospects on Sunday. "I mean, I felt good out there. It's the first time in a while I've felt confident in the car. I felt more confident in the wet than I do in the dry, I don't really understand why that was.
"I felt more like myself... unfortunately when it mattered we didn't execute."
Russell took the first win of his F1 career at Interlagos in 2022.
McLaren team boss Andre Stella acknowledged that the Briton was "probably the fastest car" in the third phase of qualifying.
"I saw that he was not impeded, but he just found Albon, and he couldn't close his second lap on inters, which I think up until that point was on par with pole position, if not faster," Stella told reporters.

(Writing by Alan Baldwin in London, editing by Pritha Sarkar)

items.title: Peña, de Paraguay, fue acusado de delitos tras ser destituido como presidente
items.author: Ken Parks
items.summary: El expresidente de Paraguay, Santiago Peña, fue imputado el sábado por su presunta implicación en la quiebra de un importante banco que desencadenó protestas generalizadas, un día después de que el Se ...
items.body: Bloomberg — El ex presidente de Paraguay, Santiago Peña, fue imputado el sábado por su presunta implicación en la quiebra de un importante banco que desencadenó protestas generalizadas, un día después de que el Senado lo destituyera de su cargo. La Fiscalía General presentó cargos contra Peña por abuso de confianza y enriquecimiento ilícito en la gestión de activos, y solicitó que se le impusiera prisión preventiva, según un comunicado publicado en la página web de la Fiscalía. El expresidente del Banco Central, Carlos Carvallo, fue acusado de abuso de confianza, falsificación de documentos y enriquecimiento ilícito. Los 44 senadores presentes votaron a favor de la destitución de Peña el viernes, después de que la Cámara Baja del Congreso respaldara por unanimidad su proceso de destitución. Ver más: Caída de Ueno Bank golpea a la economía informal de Paraguay por la lentitud en las devoluciones Peña, un aliado clave del presidente de EE. UU., Donald Trump, había ofrecido su dimisión ante la presión por sus vínculos con el Banco Ueno S.A., un banco comercial que cerró esta semana. Peña poseía una participación en la empresa matriz del banco, el Grupo Vázquez, antes de desprenderse de ella el año pasado. Peña “presuntamente intervino en decisiones relativas a la colocación, renovación y retención de fondos públicos y de la Seguridad Social en el Ueno Bank”, afirmaron los fiscales. Entre las pruebas figuran “reuniones celebradas con funcionarios del Instituto de la Seguridad Social en el contexto de decisiones relativas a inversiones en instrumentos financieros emitidos por el banco”. Al votar a favor de la destitución de Peña en lugar de aceptar su dimisión, los legisladores le negaron el escaño vitalicio sin derecho a voto en el Senado que la Constitución otorga a los expresidentes —un estatus que le habría otorgado una amplia inmunidad frente a la acción penal—. El vicepresidente Pedro Alliana tomó posesión como nuevo líder de la nación el viernes. Alliana, que superó el jueves una votación de destitución, ocupará el cargo hasta el final del mandato de Peña, que finaliza en agosto de 2028. “Esperamos con interés trabajar con el presidente Alliana y su Gobierno”, declaró el subsecretario de Estado de EE. UU. para Asuntos del Hemisferio Occidental, Juan Pablo Segura, en una publicación en X. “Paraguay es un socio estratégico, amigo y aliado de Estados Unidos”. Brasil, Chile, Perú y otros países también desearon éxito a Alliana. La saga del Banco Ueno desencadenó la mayor crisis política de Paraguay desde que el Congreso destituyera al expresidente Fernando Lugo en 2012, tras un enfrentamiento mortal entre la policía y los campesinos sin tierra. Las autoridades reguladoras intervinieron el Banco Ueno el martes por la mañana, congelando los ahorros de millones de paraguayos, incluidos los pensionistas. Esto desencadenó protestas en un país donde aproximadamente una de cada tres personas tenía depósitos en la entidad, a pesar de que el Banco Central ha comenzado a reembolsar a los ahorradores con cargo al fondo de garantía de depósitos. Algunas personas se manifestaron frente a la residencia de Peña el viernes. Ver más: La crisis bancaria empuja a un ex presidente a arrebatarle el poder a su protegido Los depósitos del Gobierno en la entidad se dispararon desde cero —cuando Peña asumió el cargo en 2023— hasta superar los 800 millones de dólares a principios de este año. Peña también eligió personalmente a un antiguo ejecutivo de Ueno para dirigir el banco central del país, lo que provocó el escrutinio público sobre los estrechos vínculos y la supervisión laxa, mientras el vertiginoso crecimiento de la entidad se producía sin control. El presidente del banco central, Carlos Carvallo, dimitió esta semana, mientras que Miguel Vázquez, propietario del Banco Ueno, fue detenido. El Gobierno ya ha realizado pagos por valor de 996 billones de guaraníes (155 millones de dólares) en casi 1,2 millones de cuentas abiertas en el Banco Ueno, según indicó Alliana en una publicación en X el sábado. Asimismo, garantizó todos los pagos de pensiones y bonificaciones después de que los fondos del Instituto de la Seguridad Social quedaran atrapados en el banco en quiebra. Es probable que la destitución de Peña ponga fin a una carrera política marcada por cambios en sus lealtades partidistas y un ascenso meteórico impulsado por su alianza con el expresidente Horacio Cartes, presidente del Partido Colorado, en el poder, y uno de los empresarios más acaudalados de Paraguay. Peña se afilió al partido mientras ocupaba el cargo de ministro de Hacienda bajo el mandato de Cartes, quien gobernó entre 2013 y 2018. Tras perder las primarias presidenciales del partido en 2017, consiguió la candidatura cinco años más tarde y ganó las elecciones en 2023. Peña realizó numerosas visitas al extranjero para reunirse con líderes extranjeros y atraer a inversores. La Administración Trump forjó estrechos vínculos con su Gobierno, favorable a las empresas, y el presidente de EE. UU. lo elogió como un «joven apuesto» en una cumbre celebrada en febrero en Washington. Ver más: Las debilidades institucionales y de control que expuso la crisis de Ueno Bank en Paraguay Los críticos solían alegar que Peña era una marioneta de Cartes. Sin embargo, rompió con el expresidente en los últimos meses, lo que provocó una mayor fragmentación del Partido Colorado. Cartes pidió públicamente su destitución el jueves, poniendo en marcha un rápido proceso de destitución que condujo a la caída de Peña. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.summary: The focus will be on inflation prints from China, the US, Germany, Japan and India. Investors will also closely track speeches by Federal Reserve officials and US employment data ...
items.body:
Home / Markets / Commodities / Bullion may remain under pressure as markets track US-Iran war, inflation

Bullion may remain under pressure as markets track US-Iran war, inflation The focus will be on inflation prints from China, the US, Germany, Japan and India. Investors will also closely track speeches by Federal Reserve officials and US employment data

On the Multi Commodity Exchange, gold futures for December delivery gained ₹3,682, or nearly 3 per cent, over the past week to close at ₹1.42 lakh per 10 grams | Image: Bloomberg

Press Trust of India New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Nov 08 2026 | 11:48 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Bullion prices are likely to remain under pressure next week as investors track developments in the US-Iran conflict, movements in crude oil prices and inflation data for cues on the outlook for interest rates, analysts said.
The focus will be on inflation prints from China, the US, Germany, Japan and India. Investors will also closely track speeches by Federal Reserve officials and US employment data.
Chinese economic indicators will be important for industrial metals, they added.
Geopolitical developments will remain a key driver after US President Donald Trump confirmed fresh military strikes on Iran, while claiming that Washington had made "a lot of progress" in negotiations with Tehran, adding another layer of uncertainty.
 

The domestic commodities market will remain closed during the morning session on Tuesday due to Diwali-Balipratipada.
Also Read

"Gold and silver's momentum remains down as investors will focus on the inflation data from China, the US, Germany, Japan, India, etc along with some Fed officials' commentary," said Pranav Mer, Senior Vice President, EBG - Commodity & Currency Research, JM Financial Services Ltd.
He said investors would also track progress in peace negotiations between the US and Iran to end the war, as well as Russia-Ukraine peace talks.
On the Multi Commodity Exchange, gold futures for December delivery gained ₹3,682, or nearly 3 per cent, over the past week to close at ₹1.42 lakh per 10 grams. Silver futures rose ₹5,655, or 3.15 per cent, to settle at ₹1.84 lakh per kilogram.

In international markets, Comex gold futures for December delivery advanced $176, or 4.5 per cent, during the week to close at $4,074.9 per ounce. Silver gained $2.6, or 5.4 per cent, to settle at $51.94 per ounce.
Mer said bullion prices initially faced pressure from stronger-than-expected US nonfarm payroll data and improving consumer sentiment, which lifted the dollar and Treasury yields.
"However, prices ended with a strong weekly gain of more than 4 per cent in global markets, following a sharp rally mid-week after the US midterm election outcome that showed Democrats sweeping wins in both the Senate and the House over the Republicans," he added.

Analysts said precious metals recovered during the week on bargain buying at lower levels and short-covering, although gains were capped by a correction in industrial metals, particularly copper.
The rally was also supported by safe-haven demand following a decline in AI, data centre and technology stocks in global markets, particularly in the US.
However, bullion futures came under selling pressure on Friday, with gold and silver closing around $4,074 and $52 per ounce, respectively, Mer said.
In the domestic market, prices could witness moderate fluctuations, with global cues, currency movements, inflation trends and festive demand around Diwali likely to influence trading.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: 米軍、オマーン湾で貨物船を航行不能に　対イラン封鎖措置強化へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［カイロ　７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［カイロ　７日　ロイター］ - 米中央軍は７日、対イラン海上封鎖の突破を図った商船を米軍機が攻撃し、航行不能にしたと発表した。

中央軍によると、セントクリストファー・ネビス船籍の貨物船は、イランの港に寄港した後、域内の海域から出ようとした。米軍は乗組員に攻撃対象の区画から退避するよう指示し、その後、米軍機が精密誘導弾で船尾を攻撃した。

米軍は７日、対イラン封鎖措置を強化する措置も発表した。イランが陸上の国境やカスピ海を経由して高性能兵器などの制裁対象物資を運ぶのを阻止するための部隊を立ち上げる。

トランプ米大統領は、イランに新たな攻撃を仕掛ける可能性を示唆している。イラン政府は米軍の基地などがある湾岸諸国に報復攻撃すると警告しており、域内諸国は警戒を強めている。

イラン国営テレビは、ホルムズ海峡にあるケシム島を含む複数の地域で７日夕、爆発音が聞かれたと伝えた。イラン当局者はこれらの地域へのミサイル攻撃を確認しておらず、イラン軍の軍事活動に関連している可能性があるという。タスニム通信は７日、ミサイル２発がケシム島に着弾したと報じたが、被害の可能性に関する公式発表はない。

またイランのイスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）海軍は８日未明、海峡内の「未承認ルート」を通過しようとした石油タンカー２隻が機雷に接触して炎上していると発表した。ＩＲＧＣが言及した事案が、イラン南部地域で聞かれた爆発音と関連しているかどうかは現時点で不明。

items.title: ネタニヤフ首相の対抗馬に8日組閣指名、イスラエル　連立交渉が鍵
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［７日　ロイター］ - イスラエルのヘルツォグ大統領は、反ネタニヤフ首相陣営を率いる中道ヤシャル党首のアイゼンコット元軍参謀総長に対し、８日に組閣を要請する。大統領報道官が７日明らかにした。アイゼンコット氏には組閣に向けて最大６週間が与えられる。１０月２７日に実施された総選挙では首相陣営、反首相陣営のいずれも過半数に届かず、連立交渉が鍵になる。

アイゼンコット氏は、国会議員から最も多い６７人の推薦を得ていた。同氏が連携を拒んでいるアラブ系政党も、ネタニヤフ氏や極右政党の政策を人種差別的と見なし、アイゼンコット氏推薦に回った。

アイゼンコット氏はＸに、「今こそ挙国一致の非常事態政府を樹立する時だ。国民の期待に応えられるよう全力を尽くす」と投稿した。

＜連立交渉は厳しく＞

国会総選挙（定数１２０）では、ネタニヤフ氏の右派リクードが単独政党として最多の２７議席を獲得。アイゼンコット氏が率いる「ヤシャル」は２１議席で第２党となった。ただ、ネタニヤフ氏の宗教・民族主義連立陣営全体では５３議席、中道左派から右派までのユダヤ系４政党から成るアイゼンコット氏の陣営は４８議席といずれも過半数の６１議席に届かなかった。こうした中、アラブ系少数派を代表する２政党が過去最多となる１９議席を獲得した。

アイゼンコット政権発足に向けた選択肢は３つ考えられる。一つは、アラブ系政党から閣外協力を得て少数派政権を樹立する、２つ目は、同氏や盟友らが過去に避けてきたユダヤ教超正統派政党と連立を組む、３つ目はネタニヤフ氏と挙国一致政権を樹立することだ。

アナリストらは、３つの選択肢はいずれも実現しそうにないとみている。アイゼンコット氏が合意をまとめられなければ、別の候補者が４週間の期限で組閣に挑み、それも不調となれば議会が別の候補者を指名できる。手続き全体の期限は約１００日で、誰も組閣に成功しなければ再選挙となる。

Adani Enterprises plans ₹35,000-₹40,000 cr annual capex in next two years The planned spending comes as the group seeks to scale up businesses built over recent years, including airports and data centres

Adani Enterprises, the flagship incubator of the Adani Group, reported its highest-ever half-year EBITDA of ₹11,958 crore for the six months ended September 2026, an increase of 56 per cent from a year earlier (Photo: Reuters)

Press Trust of India New Delhi 4 min read Last Updated : Nov 08 2026 | 10:52 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Adani Enterprises Ltd plans to spend between ₹35,000 crore and ₹40,000 crore annually over the next couple of years, with airports, data centres and its proposed PVC complex emerging as the biggest investment drivers as the conglomerate steps up expansion across its infrastructure businesses.
"We expect to do capex at a run rate of around ₹40,000 crore. So, we may be somewhere in the range of ₹35,000 crore to ₹40,000 crore, which is the rate we expect to continue over the next couple of years," Manan Vakharia, head of finance at Adani Enterprises, said during the company's earnings call.
The planned spending comes as the group seeks to scale up businesses built over recent years, including airports and data centres, while bringing its large manufacturing investments closer to commercial operation.
 

"The heavy lifting will be done by airports, data centres and PVC," Vakharia said.
Adani Enterprises, the flagship incubator of the Adani Group, reported its highest-ever half-year EBITDA of ₹11,958 crore for the six months ended September 2026, an increase of 56 per cent from a year earlier.
