Consolidated income rose 62 per cent to ₹71,569 crore, while profit before tax from continuing operations increased 45 per cent to ₹3,297 crore.
Chief Executive Officer Arun Bansal said the company was progressively moving from a "build-out phase to value realisation phase", as investments made over the past few years begin contributing more meaningfully to earnings.

The airport business and data centres are central to that transition. Adani Airport Holdings reported a 52 per cent increase in first-half EBITDA to ₹3,275 crore, while AdaniConneX, its data-centre joint venture, has expanded its contracted capacity to more than 1.2 gigawatts.
AdaniConneX signed a new 240-megawatt hyperscale contract during the September quarter. Its operational capacity stood at 94.6 MW after handing over an additional 29.2 MW to customers during the period.
The company expects operational capacity to reach 120-150 MW by the end of the current financial year and approach 500 MW over the following 12-18 months, when the facilities are expected to begin generating billing revenue.

Of the 1.4 GW of data-centre capacity being developed, 1.2 GW has already been tied up and is at different stages of implementation and construction, its management said.
The airport portfolio, which comprises eight airports, including Navi Mumbai International Airport, accounts for about 23 per cent of India's passenger traffic and 29 per cent of its air cargo volumes, according to the company officials.
Adani Airport Holdings handled 21.3 million passengers in the September quarter. Its revenue rose 20 per cent year-on-year to ₹3,786 crore, while EBITDA increased 55 per cent to ₹1,641 crore. Non-aeronautical revenue grew 57 per cent, significantly faster than the 9 per cent increase in aeronautical revenue.

Navi Mumbai International Airport began international operations on July 15.
The Management expects the airport to reach its full annual capacity of 20 million passengers by the end of FY28, supported by the expansion of domestic and international routes and the transfer of some international flights from existing Mumbai airports.
The company's other major investment is a 1-million-tonne-per-annum PVC manufacturing complex at Mundra, Gujarat, involving capital expenditure of about ₹26,000 crore.
Around 60 per cent of the project spending and construction has been completed, and the first part of the complex is expected to be commissioned in the next financial year. The facility will also include related chemicals and chlor-alkali operations.

Separately, Adani Enterprises has completed the expansion of its solar module manufacturing capacity to 10 GW and expects to commission 6 GW of solar cell capacity by the end of the current financial year. The company sold 1,478 MW of solar modules in the September quarter, up 35 per cent from a year earlier.
The proposed investment cycle will require the company to balance expansion with project execution and the generation of returns from newly commissioned assets.
Management did not provide a specific EBITDA forecast for FY27.

items.title: トランプ氏、民主党「脅迫」の調査指示　証拠示さず
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ワシントン　７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ワシントン　７日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は７日、民主党が弾劾などの処罰をちらつかせて「多くの人々を脅している」として、司法省に調査を指示した。交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で、民主党の行動は「犯罪行為」に当たると主張したが、証拠は示さなかった。

３日の中間選挙では民主党が圧勝し、２０２７年１月から議会の主導権を握ることになった。民主党指導部は、多数派になった後は公聴会を開き、トランプ政権の行動を調査することで、行政府に対する議会の監視機能を取り戻す方針を示している。

トランプ氏は投稿で、民主党が「多くの人々に脅迫状を送っている。全員無実だ」と非難。同党のエリッサ・スロットキン上院議員（ミシガン州選出）にも触れた。

スロットキン氏は１０月のシカゴ大学での講演で、トランプ氏の政策に手を貸した人々を議会が調査すべきだとの考えを示していた。

スロットキン氏は、元中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）分析官で、国家安全保障分野の経歴を持つ民主党議員グループの一員だった。このグループは軍人や情報機関職員に政権の違法な命令に従わないよう呼び掛ける動画を投稿し、司法省が捜査に乗り出したことがあった。結局、大陪審は議員らの起訴請求を退けた。

スロットキン氏は７日、ＳＮＳへの投稿で、この問題は論争になるようなものではないと指摘。「法律を破ったり、税金を使って私腹を肥やしたりすれば、責任を問われるべきだ。法律を破っていなければ、何の問題もない」と述べた。

司法省はコメントの要請に応じていない。

items.title: Trump says he wants UFC chief Dana White for White House press secretary
items.summary: The White House press secretary role has been vacant since Katie Zacharia's tenure ended last month after less than a week ...
items.body:
Home / World News / Trump says he wants UFC chief Dana White for White House press secretary

Trump says he wants UFC chief Dana White for White House press secretary The White House press secretary role has been vacant since Katie Zacharia's tenure ended last month after less than a week

US President Donald Trump (Photo:PTI)

Reuters WASHINGTON 2 min read Last Updated : Nov 08 2026 | 9:17 AM IST

Listen to This Article

US President Donald Trump on Saturday said he had asked mixed martial arts promoter Dana White to serve as White House press secretary and called on him to bring some fighters along as assistants "even though some are not from our country."
  White, chief executive of the Ultimate Fighting Championship, is a "violent Fighter and Warrior," Trump wrote in a Truth Social post.
  Trump also asked for six current or former UFC titleholders to join White, including two athletes from Russia's Dagestan region, Islam Makhachev and Khabib Nurmagomedov; Americans Justin Gaethje, Daniel Cormier and "Kayla Harris," likely a reference to Kayla Harrison; and Amanda Nunes, a Brazilian native who became a US citizen last year.
 

  "We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left," Trump wrote.
  Speaking at a press conference on Saturday while in London after a boxing event, White said he would meet with Trump at the White House on Monday.

  The White House press secretary role has been vacant since Katie Zacharia's tenure ended last month after less than a week. Zacharia replaced Karoline Leavitt, who left the role at the end of August.
  White and Trump first worked together in the early 2000s, when Trump's Taj Mahal casino hosted some UFC events. But they have become closer allies since the UFC chief publicly backed Trump's presidential campaign in 2016.

  Trump in recent years has attended several UFC events, and in June the White House hosted a night of UFC fights as part of celebrations marking the 250th anniversary of US independence.
  The White House press office already has a former UFC spokesperson in White House Director of Communications Steven Cheung, who worked for White's organization from 2013 to 2016.

Nov 7 : Tesla will add an extra production shift to try to complete outstanding Cybertruck orders before dismantling the line next year for a planned expansion of Cybercab production, CEO Elon Musk said on Saturday.
"The Cybertruck order backlog is currently far more than Tesla can make before dismantling the line for Cybercab expansion around June/July next year," Musk said in a post on X.
"We will add an extra shift to try to get all orders done in time," he added.
The comments come a day after Musk said Tesla would wind down Cybertruck production at its Texas factory and shift resources toward the Cybercab, a two-seat robotaxi that he has made central to the automaker's autonomous-vehicle ambitions.

The Cybercab is one of Musk's key bets in his push to turn Tesla into an AI and robotics company rather than just an automaker.
The Cybertruck, which began reaching customers in late 2023, has struggled to meet Musk's early expectations. US sales fell to about 20,000 vehicles last year from nearly 39,000 in 2024, according to Kelley Blue Book, far below Musk's initial prediction of 250,000 annual sales.
The stainless steel pickup has also faced repeated recalls and quality concerns since launch, while its unconventional design limited prospects in overseas markets including Europe.

Nov 7 : Binance's finance chief Kaiser Ng is leaving the company to pursue another venture, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange said days after hackers stole $6.3 billion from the platform in a record heist.
"Kaiser Ng has decided to pursue a new venture after more than five years at Binance, with a transition plan implemented over the last half year," Binance Co-Chief Executive Officer Yi He said in a statement on Saturday.
Justin Yek, a longtime finance executive who was most recently vice-president of finance at Airwallex, is taking over as CFO.
The announcement comes just over a week after Binance said hackers stole cryptocurrency in a sophisticated attack that began months earlier with the compromise of several employees' computers.

Binance has said the breach, which unfolded on October 29, started with malware hidden in software downloads and fake job recruitment efforts targeting engineers. It said it will fully reimburse affected customers.
The FBI has blamed a North Korean hacking group for the theft, an allegation Pyongyang has denied.
Ng has been CFO at Binance since January 2022 and has previously worked at rival crypto exchange Kraken, according to his LinkedIn profile.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ロシア、一時管理下のＪＴ傘下企業を3社追加　新たに大統領令
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[７日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は、一時管理下に置く日本たばこ産業（ＪＴ）傘下のロシア資産を拡大、新たに３社を対象に加えた。

プーチン氏は５日、ＪＴの海外子会社、ＪＴインターナショナル（ＪＴＩ）のロシア資産を一時管理下に置く大統領令に署名、ＪＴＩがロシアに保有する４社がインダストリアル・アセッツの管理下に置かれた。

夜間に公表された今回の大統領令では、対象を３社追加。いずれもＪＴＩインベストメンツが保有する企業で、インタファクス通信によると、３社は輸入、経営管理、持ち株会社としての機能を担っている。

一方、ロシアのメディアＲＢＣは７日、インダストリアル・アセッツのアントン・ピボバロフ代表が、生産と既存の人員体制を維持し、従業員や取引先に対する義務を滞りなく履行することを目指すと述べたと報じた。

大統領令は今回の措置の理由を示していない。ロシア大統領府はこれまで、同様の資産接収について、ロシアに敵対的と見なす国々の行動に対応したものだと説明している。

ロシア事業はＪＴグループの売上高の約１０％、営業利益の約２５％を占める。

items.title: How the Iran War Is Making Alaskans Both Richer and Poorer
items.summary: Oil prices have surged across the United States as a result of the ongoing war in Iran. This means higher costs for households in most states, but in Alaska, the state government is bringing in new revenue from its high oil production to offset those higher costs. Some of the revenue is then redistributed to Alaskans through the state’s unique sovereign wealth fund. While most Americans disapprove of the war in Iran, Alaska may emerge as a quiet winner from one of the conflict’s most painful economic side effects: higher oil prices. (Source: Bloomberg)

While most Americans disapprove of the war in Iran, Alaska may emerge as a quiet winner from one of the conflict’s most painful economic side effects: higher oil prices. (Source: Bloomberg)

Nov 7 : Russian President Vladimir Putin has expanded the list of Japan Tobacco International (JTI) businesses placed under temporary administration in Russia, adding three more companies to those included in the original order issued on Thursday.
On Thursday, Putin signed a decree transferring the Russian assets of JTI, part of Japan Tobacco Inc. and Russia's largest tobacco manufacturer, to temporary management, making the tobacco group the latest foreign company to lose control of local operations as Moscow tightens its grip on overseas-owned assets.
According to the original decree, the stakes in four JTI businesses were placed under the administration of Russian company Industrial Assets.
A separate decree, published overnight, extended the measure to three additional companies, all owned by JTI Investments Sarl According to Interfax news agency, the three firms acted as import, management and holding companies.

Separately, Russian media outlet RBC on Saturday quoted Anton Pivovarov, head of Industrial Assets, as saying the company would seek to maintain production, preserve existing teams and fulfil obligations to employees and business partners without disruption.
Putin's decrees gave no reason for the move, but the Kremlin has previously linked similar asset seizures to actions taken by countries it considers hostile to Russia.
In an emailed statement issued after the first decree, JTI said it was aware of the decision and was "assessing the situation and our options, prioritising our stakeholders, most notably our employees".
The Japanese government owns around 37 per cent of shares in Japan Tobacco Inc., whose brands include Winston and Camel cigarettes.
The Russian business accounts for about 10 per cent of Japan Tobacco Group's revenue and roughly 25 per cent of its operating profit.

Source: Reuters

items.author: CNA
items.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 7 : Billions of years from now, the sun is expected to run out of fuel and greatly expand into what is called a red giant, eventually shedding its outer layers and leaving behind its dense core, a white dwarf. Astronomers spot white dwarf star with two rings of planetary debris

Artist's impression shows two gaseous discs of debris from planetary wreckage around the white dwarf J1328−1450 –– the dead core of a star similar to our sun that expelled its outer layers at the end of its lifetime. The star was suspected to have had a planetary system that was vaporized to rubble as the star died, and this debris ended up arranged in a disc arrangement like the one shown here, in this handout image released by the European Southern Observatory on October 27, 2026. ESO/L. Calcada/Handout via REUTERS

WASHINGTON, Nov 7 : Billions of years from now, the sun is expected to run out of fuel and greatly expand into what is called a red giant, eventually shedding its outer layers and leaving behind its dense core, a white dwarf. Some of the planets in our solar system would be destroyed while others might survive.
Researchers have now spotted a white dwarf with planetary debris swirling around it in an unusual configuration that may offer a peek into one possible outcome for our solar system in the distant future.
Unlike in similar systems previously observed, the debris disc surrounding this white dwarf appears to consist of two distinct rings. The researchers said the disc may have been shaped by two planetary or smaller rocky bodies that are embedded in the rings after managing to survive the star's violent death throes.
The white dwarf, named J1328−1450, is located in the Milky Way roughly 1,600 light-years from Earth, in the constellation Virgo. A light-year is the distance light travels in a year, 5.9 trillion miles (9.5 trillion km). The observations were made using the European Southern Observatory's Chile-based Very Large Telescope.

Prior to this discovery, astronomers had identified 21 white dwarfs with debris surrounding them, all of which had a single disc and not a double ring of material as the new observations reveal.
"It shows that the remnants of a planetary system can have a much more complex structure than we previously thought, and provides further support to the idea that planetary rocky bodies may survive the transformation of a star into a white dwarf," said astronomer Felipe Lagos-Vilches of Universidad Técnica Federico Santa María in Chile, one of the authors of the study published in the journal Nature Astronomy.
The white dwarf has a mass about 47 per cent that of the sun, jam-packed into a diameter roughly the same as that of Earth.
The surviving planetary bodies may be remnants of larger and heavily disrupted planets. One of them may be around the size of the dwarf planet Pluto, with the other one smaller than that.
Lagos-Vilches said the original star may have hosted a planetary system before it expanded dramatically into a red giant, engulfing some of the innermost planets while ones with more distant orbits survived.
"The planetary system did not completely disappear. Some surviving rocky bodies may have been gravitationally perturbed onto highly eccentric orbits that brought them close to the white dwarf," Lagos-Vilches said.
"Objects that came sufficiently close were disrupted by the white dwarf's gravitational force. Their material was spread into a debris disc containing dust and gas. However, two relatively large rocky bodies may have survived within this debris," Lagos-Vilches said. 
The presence of the two bodies may help explain the distribution of the surrounding material into a pair of concentric gaseous rings, Lagos-Vilches said. 
"The outer ring is strongly depleted in magnesium compared with the inner ring. This suggests that they may originate from different parent bodies, or possibly from different layers of a rocky body that was disrupted when it went too close to the white dwarf due to its strong gravitational field," Lagos-Vilches said.
A GLIMPSE OF THE FUTURE
In about 5 billion years, the sun will become a red giant, Lagos-Vilches said.
"It will eventually lose its outer layers and become a white dwarf. The inner solar system will be dramatically affected. Mercury and Venus are expected to be engulfed by the expanding sun, while there is still no clear consensus on whether Earth will also be engulfed during this phase. The fate of the outer planets is different. Jupiter, Saturn and the more distant bodies should have a much better chance of surviving," Lagos-Vilches said.
After the sun becomes a white dwarf, surviving planetary remnants, moons and asteroids could potentially be drawn close enough to the white dwarf to be torn apart by gravitational forces.
"A debris disc like the one around J1328−1450 could therefore represent one possible stage in the very distant future of our own planetary system," Lagos-Vilches said.

Source: Reuters

items.title: US Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed launches 'Habibi PAC' days after historic election win
items.summary: Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed has launched a political action committee (PAC) named 'Habibi PAC', days after becoming the first Muslim member of the United States Senate, Al Jazeera reported.
items.body:
US Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed launches 'Habibi PAC' days after historic election win Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed has launched a political action committee (PAC) named 'Habibi PAC', days after becoming the first Muslim member of the United States Senate, Al Jazeera reported.
ANI | Updated: 07-11-2026 21:32 IST | Created: 07-11-2026 21:32 IST

Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed has launched a political action committee (PAC) named 'Habibi PAC', days after becoming the first Muslim member of the United States Senate, Al Jazeera reported. According to Al Jazeera, citing a filing submitted to the Federal Election Commission (FEC) on Thursday, Habibi PAC has been registered as a leadership PAC sponsored by El-Sayed. Such committees operate separately from a politician's own election campaign and are used to raise and spend funds in support of other political candidates and political activities.
The name 'Habibi', an Arabic term of endearment meaning 'my dear' or 'my beloved', is a phrase El-Sayed frequently used during his election campaign. He also used the expression while addressing US Vice President JD Vance during his victory speech in Detroit, saying, "JD, habibi, there is this delicious irony in the fact that you’re constitutionally obligated to swear me in in January."
El-Sayed is among several newly elected Democratic lawmakers who have registered leadership PACs following Tuesday's election, according to FEC filings. Others include Arizona Congressman-elect Amish Shah, who registered 'PACStreet Boy', Iowa Senator-elect Josh Turek, who launched 'WheelPAC', and North Carolina Senator-elect Roy Cooper, who registered 'One NC PAC', as reported by Al Jazeera.
According to Al Jazeera, citing OpenSecrets, leadership PACs are often used by ambitious lawmakers to build influence among their colleagues and strengthen their prospects of securing party leadership positions or committee chairmanships. They typically contribute to other lawmakers, political parties and political committees.
During the 2024 election cycle, leadership PACs contributed USD 79.3 million to federal candidates. While most of the contributions went to Republican candidates, a Democratic leadership PAC emerged as the largest individual donor, Al Jazeera reported, citing OpenSecrets. El-Sayed, the son of Egyptian immigrants, defeated Republican candidate Mike Rogers following a campaign in which US President Donald Trump, Vice President JD Vance and Senator Ted Cruz questioned his loyalty, called him a "jihadist" and attempted to link him to the Muslim Brotherhood movement without providing evidence.
Getting money out of politics was among El-Sayed's central campaign pledges. During his victory speech, he highlighted the significance of his electoral success, saying that in a contest between money and the people, "the many can win". His victory came amid the most expensive midterm election on record.
According to Al Jazeera, an analysis of FEC data by OpenSecrets noted that total spending in the election cycle is expected to reach USD 11.9 billion, compared with USD 8.9 billion in 2022. Outside spending, largely driven by super PACs, is projected to reach USD 3.9 billion, marking an 85 per cent increase from the 2022 midterm elections.
Meanwhile, so-called dark money contributions from donors whose identities are not disclosed have already reached at least USD 1.47 billion, surpassing the previous record of USD 1.35 billion set during the 2024 election cycle, which also included the presidential race. According to Al Jazeera, OpenSecrets found that conservative groups outspent liberal groups by approximately USD 360 million in outside spending, while Democratic candidates were expected to outspend their Republican counterparts by around USD 800 million.
Political action committees, or PACs, are organisations that raise and spend money to support or oppose candidates for public office. Leadership PACs, in particular, allow elected officials and lawmakers to support other candidates and political organisations independently of their own campaign committees. (ANI)

items.title: Gaza rains flood 70,000 tents housing displaced Palestinians as first winter storm hits Strip
items.summary: Around 70,000 tents sheltering displaced Palestinian families have been flooded across the Gaza Strip within 12 hours of the first winter storm of the season, leaving thousands exposed to heavy ...
items.body:
Gaza rains flood 70,000 tents housing displaced Palestinians as first winter storm hits Strip Around 70,000 tents sheltering displaced Palestinian families have been flooded across the Gaza Strip within 12 hours of the first winter storm of the season, leaving thousands exposed to heavy rainfall, rising water levels and harsh weather conditions, Al Jazeera reported, citing Gaza's Government Media Office.
ANI | Updated: 07-11-2026 21:17 IST | Created: 07-11-2026 21:17 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

Country:

Palestine

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Around 70,000 tents sheltering displaced Palestinian families have been flooded across the Gaza Strip within 12 hours of the first winter storm of the season, leaving thousands exposed to heavy rainfall, rising water levels and harsh weather conditions, Al Jazeera reported, citing Gaza's Government Media Office. In a statement issued on Saturday, the Government Media Office estimated the initial losses from the flooding at approximately USD 3 million.
It also reported that dozens of walls had collapsed, several people had sustained injuries and damaged buildings at risk of further collapse posed an additional threat to residents. The office held Israel "fully responsible" for a disaster resulting from the continued closure of border crossings and restrictions on the entry of shelter and reconstruction materials.
It also called on the international community and United Nations agencies to intervene immediately to protect displaced Palestinians, Al Jazeera reported. According to Gaza's Civil Defence agency, rescue teams received around 1,500 distress calls within just 10 hours after rainfall began early Saturday. Water levels at several displacement sites reportedly rose by 30 to 40 centimetres.
Describing the situation, Civil Defence spokesperson Mahmoud Basal told Al Jazeera that several shelter centres had been completely inundated, forcing residents to leave their tents. “What we feared has actually happened,” Basal told Al Jazeera.
“A few shelter centres were completely flooded, and everyone inside them has now been forced out into the unknown," he added. He warned that vulnerable groups, particularly premature babies, elderly people and those suffering from illnesses, faced the greatest risks amid the worsening weather conditions.
“Those living in tents are at risk of death at any moment, and of illness at any moment,” he said, as quoted by Al Jazeera. The storm also caused further damage to buildings already weakened during Israel's war on the enclave, which began in October 2023.
Gaza's Civil Defence agency said rescue teams evacuated residents from a building in the central Nuseirat area after it partially collapsed amid strong winds and rainfall. In northern Gaza, the wall of another building collapsed following heavy rainfall, injuring two people, according to the Palestinian news agency Wafa. Footage from displacement camps in Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah showed families wading through ankle-deep water, with mattresses and blankets soaked in rainwater and children standing barefoot in muddy and sewage-contaminated pools.
In Khan Younis, Al Jazeera reported that rainfall had begun around 10 pm (local time) on Friday in al-Mawasi, the coastal area in southern Gaza where more than 900,000 displaced people are sheltering. Gaza's emergency committee warned that more than one million displaced people were facing a difficult winter and said the territory urgently required approximately 200,000 tents, along with heating supplies.
Highlighting the limited resources available to rescue teams, Raed al-Dahshan, director of Civil Defence in Gaza, told Al Jazeera that crews lacked even basic shelter materials to assist affected families. “Civil defence does not have a single tarpaulin or a single tent,” al-Dahshan said.
“We deal only with saving lives, and that is not enough," he added. Aid organisations have blamed Israeli restrictions on the entry of shelter materials for the shortage of essential supplies.
The rainfall has also affected Gaza's already battered healthcare infrastructure. Mohammed Abu Salmiya, director of al-Shifa Medical Complex in Gaza City, told Al Jazeera that the hospital's emergency department was flooded and remained out of service for approximately four hours. He warned that the mixing of sewage with rainwater inside displacement tents could lead to an increase in gastrointestinal, respiratory and skin infections.
“We will see many deaths, in the dozens and perhaps the hundreds, among newborns who need warmth in these tents,” Abu Salmiya said. In Gaza City port, Al Jazeera reported that thousands of displaced families had established tents along the shoreline, leaving them exposed to strong winds and rising tides.
Many of the tents currently sheltering displaced Palestinians were initially set up during the first year of displacement and are now in their fourth year of use. Families have repeatedly patched and re-stitched them to keep them functional. Under the humanitarian protocol of the ceasefire, the tents were supposed to be replaced with caravans, which Israel has not allowed into the territory.
Highlighting the desperation among displaced families, one man living in a tent along the beach told Al Jazeera, “They pushed us west towards the sea. Why don’t they just throw us into the sea and be done with it?” Meanwhile, Mohammed Salha, director of the Palestinian NGO Network, told Al Jazeera that only 180 to 200 trucks were entering Gaza daily, significantly below the 600 trucks agreed upon under the humanitarian protocol of the ceasefire. He added that only around 40 of the trucks were carrying humanitarian assistance.
He also said that approximately 50,000 tents were waiting on the Egyptian side of the border. "We must respond before the disaster happens," he said, describing international pressure on Israel to allow additional supplies into Gaza as "timid". (ANI)

items.title: カタール、米イラン仲介継続　「大きな進展」と首相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［７日　ロイター］ - カタールのムハンマド首相は、地域情勢が制御不能に陥るのを防ぐため、米国とイランの仲介を続けていると述べた。衛星テレビ局アルジャジーラが７日報じた。

ムハンマド氏は、米政権は中間選挙後も解決策を見いだす意欲を維持しており、合意を目指す姿勢に変わりがないことを示していると述べた。

また、これまでに大きな進展があったとし、解決に向けた合意に達することができるとの自信を示した。「完璧な合意に達するまで待つわけにはいかない。良い合意に達することを望んでいる」と語った。

一方、イランの準国営タスニム通信は７日、初期段階の情報によるとケシム島にミサイル２発が着弾したもようだと報じた。被害の有無について公式情報はないとしている。米国は現時点で攻撃について発表していない。

トランプ米大統領は３日の中間選挙に先立つ数週間、イランへの攻撃を見合わせていたが、域内諸国は米国が選挙後に攻撃を再開する可能性があると見込んでいた。イランは、新たな攻撃を受ければ近隣諸国にある米国とイスラエルの標的を攻撃して報復すると繰り返し表明している。

items.title: 英メーガン妃の父親逮捕、子どもの性的虐待画像所持の疑い
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ワシントン　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ワシントン　６日　ロイター］ - 英国のヘンリー王子の妻メーガン妃の父親トーマス・マークル容疑者（８２）が６日、子どもの性的虐待画像を所持した疑いで逮捕、訴追された。画像はカリフォルニア州の貸倉庫から見つかり、裸の未成年の少女と容疑者が一緒に写った写真も含まれている。

パテル米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）長官によると、容疑者はフロリダ州で連邦捜査官に身柄を拘束された。英紙デーリー・メールによると、容疑者は同州の介護施設に入所しており、車椅子を使用しているという。

パテル氏は声明で「罪のない子どもたちを標的にし、犯罪行為によってその純真さを奪おうとした疑いがある」と説明した。司法省によると、有罪となれば最高で禁錮２０年の刑が科される可能性がある。 

容疑者は、フロリダ州タンパで連邦治安判事の前に初出廷した。ロサンゼルスの連邦検察当局の声明によると、判事は自宅拘禁と電子監視に従うことを条件に、裁判を待つ間の釈放を命じた。 

声明によると、罪状認否はまだ行われておらず、数週間先になる見通し。

英王室とメーガン妃の広報担当者は、コメントの要請に応じなかった。

Environmental groups embrace AI, even as they warn of data center impacts

WASHINGTON, Nov 7 : Environmental groups worldwide are using artificial intelligence to analyze climate data, track forest fires and count endangered wildlife – embracing a technology they also warn is driving a surge in electricity demand, water use and greenhouse-gas emissions.
The contradiction is forcing these organizations to justify their AI use in carrying out missions to combat climate change or protect natural resources.
"We recognize that AI can come with environmental costs, and we need to be thoughtful about how we use it," said Ali Swanson, AI lead at the US nonprofit Conservation International. "But at a time when the climate and biodiversity crises are becoming more urgent, AI can help us move faster and make better use of the information we're collecting."
The group recently started using AI to assess hotspots detected by satellites and send real-time alerts to community forest patrols about potential wildfires in remote and environmentally sensitive parts of Cambodia.

Reuters interviewed 15 major environmental, conservation and development organizations about their AI use. All said they used the technology in some form and expressed concern about the environmental impact of the data centers powering it. The centers, filled with servers, can require vast amounts of electricity, along with water for cooling.
It's a global dilemma for individuals, governments and industries balancing AI's benefits with its enormous risks. The tradeoffs likely will grab attention at the UN's COP31 climate conference this month, when host Turkey will call on governments, businesses and other institutions to sign a pledge outlining principles to ensure AI is developed and deployed sustainably.
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres wants major AI companies to publicly disclose their systems' environmental impacts.
Researchers at the United Nations University Institute for Water, Environment and Health estimate the global data-center footprint could more than double by 2030, reaching a size about twice that of Jakarta, the Indonesian megalopolis.
The International Energy Agency, meanwhile, estimates global data centers will consume about 945 terawatt-hours of electricity annually by 2030, producing the equivalent of more than 300 million metric tons of carbon dioxide. That's double current consumption and about equal to Japan's annual electricity use.
The agency also projects that global data center water consumption will increase from about 560 billion liters (147.9 billion gallons) in 2023 to about 1.2 trillion liters (317 billion gallons) annually by 2030.
Technology giants including Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet's Google have reported rising emissions linked in part to data center expansion, raising questions about their ability to meet their own long-term climate goals.
Amazon told Reuters its artificial-intelligence products were among the most sustainable due to the company's purchases of low-carbon energy and its efforts to use power and water efficiently.
Microsoft and Google didn't respond to requests for comment.
BREAKTHROUGHS ONCE THOUGHT IMPOSSIBLE
Many of the organizations that spoke to Reuters believe AI's benefits currently outweigh its costs because the technology is enabling work that was previously difficult, expensive or impossible.
Kenya's Save the Elephants, a partner of the Wildlife Conservation Network, said it is using machine learning to improve population surveys and study elephant communication.
Frank Pope, the group's chief executive, said an aerial survey of Kenya's largest protected area last year generated roughly 200,000 images that took nine people nine months to review manually. AI models trained on Nvidia's GeForce graphics platforms can now complete similar analyses in hours.
"The results have been eye-opening," Pope said. "We found that human surveys were missing about a third of the elephants, roughly half of zebras and giraffes, and three-quarters of oryx populations."
More accurate wildlife data can help secure financing for conservation, he said.
"Ultimately, these tools make nature measurable and therefore investable," he said. "That's a critical transformation, if we're going to conserve biodiversity at scale."
At the institute founded by the late conservation icon Jane Goodall, researchers are using AI to digitize decades of field notes about chimpanzee behavior in Tanzania's Gombe National Park.
The project was once expected to take 13-15 years because the records were written by hand using the local Kiha language and scientific shorthand.
Thanks to a tool developed with Amazon Web Services, the notes can now be scanned, translated and structured in minutes, slashing the time needed to about two years, said Lilian Pintea, the Jane Goodall Institute's vice president of conservation science.
During her lifetime, Pintea said, Goodall supported the use of AI to advance conservation science, provided people remained firmly in control of how it was used.
"AI technology should be seen as tools which are human-centered," Pintea said.
LIMITING THE ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT
Some organizations are experimenting with ways to limit the environmental impact of their AI use.
The World Resources Institute (WRI), a research group that uses AI to accelerate its climate and environmental analyses, said it limits resource-intensive applications such as generating videos and images, while caching AI query results so identical searches don't need to be reprocessed.
The US-based Nature Conservancy has adopted a similar approach. It uses AI to analyze video captured on commercial fishing vessels for information on how many fish of different species they catch. But instead of uploading huge numbers of videos to centralized data centers, it has installed AI-powered digital cameras to process information aboard the vessels, reducing energy use and data-transfer requirements, said Vienna Saccomanno, a senior scientist at the organization.
"It takes a lot of engineering to make computation on the edge possible," she said. "This was worth it to reduce both our carbon footprint and deliver these sustainability insights."
Greenpeace International said it, too, uses some AI tools, mainly because software platforms it relies upon include AI features.
It's imposing internal guidelines emphasizing transparency, human oversight and "intentional" AI use, the group said. But it would prefer to sidestep the technology due to its environmental impacts and is pushing back hard on the data center buildout.
"While other organizations are asking how to use AI responsibly, Greenpeace is asking whether it's necessary to build all these massive data centers in the first place," said Katrin Xueying Wu, a climate and energy campaigner with the organization.
Other groups now see AI as vital to effective environmental activism.
"It's our job to save the planet. If we can do that more effectively and efficiently with the limited resources we've got by using AI, then we have to seriously engage in that possibility," said Stuart Butchart, chief scientist at UK-based BirdLife International.
"If we don't do it, then we're sort of being derelict in our duty."

(Additonal reporting by Simon Jessop in London and Kate Abnett in Brussels; Editing by Richard Valdmanis and Alexandra Zavis)

items.title: Pakistan smothers with smog as pollution levels reach hazardous extremes
items.summary: Severe smog and worsening air quality have engulfed several major cities across Pakistan’s Punjab province, including Islamabad and Rawalpindi, exposing residents to serious health risks.
items.body:
Pakistan smothers with smog as pollution levels reach hazardous extremes Severe smog and worsening air quality have engulfed several major cities across Pakistan’s Punjab province, including Islamabad and Rawalpindi, exposing residents to serious health risks.
ANI | Updated: 07-11-2026 18:58 IST | Created: 07-11-2026 18:58 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Severe smog and worsening air quality have engulfed several major cities across Pakistan’s Punjab province, including Islamabad and Rawalpindi, exposing residents to serious health risks. The worsening pollution has triggered a surge in respiratory illnesses, asthma, throat infections, eye irritation, colds and persistent coughing, as reported by The Express Tribune.
According to The Express Tribune, the scale of the health emergency is becoming increasingly evident in Rawalpindi, where 2,961 patients suffering from smog-related ailments sought treatment at the outpatient departments and emergency wards of three allied hospitals within just 48 hours. Most of those affected were elderly men and women, highlighting the vulnerability of older residents to hazardous air conditions. Air quality readings have painted an alarming picture across the region.
Islamabad recorded an Air Quality Index (AQI) of 187, while Rawalpindi registered 179. Lahore's AQI surged to 530, whereas Multan recorded an exceptionally dangerous 719. Faisalabad stood at 371, while Gujranwala recorded levels between 600 and 660. Jhang's AQI reached 678, while Murree, popularly known as the Queen of Hills, crossed 123. Industrial centres such as Gujranwala, Faisalabad and Jhang are among the worst affected. Authorities fear that pollution levels could rise further if rainfall does not occur over the following three days.
Medical professionals and health authorities have advised residents to wear protective masks, particularly outdoors. Children and individuals with respiratory conditions have been urged to avoid unnecessary outdoor exposure. People have also been advised to keep doors and windows shut during morning and evening hours and seek medical guidance before using eye drops, as cited by The Express Tribune.
The Environmental Protection Department has identified brick kilns, stone crushers, industrial emissions, vehicle exhaust, crop-residue burning and the extraction of black oil through burning discarded tyres as major contributors to the crisis. Smoke-emitting vehicles have been described as a particularly serious pollution source, as reported by The Express Tribune. (ANI)

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝セルティックス快勝、シクサーズは連勝ストップ　ＮＢＡカップ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は６日、シーズン中のトーナメント戦であるＮＢＡカップを各地で行い、東カンファレンスＣ組のセルティックスはホーネッツに１１９─８０で快勝した。

セルティックスはジェイソン・テイタムが両チーム最多の３４得点に、８リバウンド、９アシストとトリプルダブル級の活躍。チームは前半だけで７０得点を挙げてホーネッツを突き放した。同組のホークスはウィザーズに１３９─１３２で勝利した。

Ｂ組のキャバリアーズはセブンティシクサーズを１１９─９５で下した。ドノバン・ミッチェルが２３得点、７リバウンド、８アシストで攻撃をけん引。シクサーズは公式戦連勝が５でストップした。Ａ組ではラプターズがバックスに１２１─１０７で勝利した。

西カンファレンスＢ組のサンダーは、グリズリーズに１２８─９７で快勝した。エイジェイ・ミッチェルが両チーム最多の３５得点をマーク。シェイ・ギルジャス・アレクサンダーは２８得点を挙げた。

同組のティンバーウルブズはペリカンズに１１５─１０９で競り勝った。Ａ組ではマーベリックスがジャズに１１２─１００で勝利した。

items.summary: Leaders of several major political parties in Balochistan have announced a province-wide shutdown strike on November 19, followed by demonstrations at all district headquarters, accusing the ...
items.body:
Balochistan parties announce province-wide shutdown amid deepening crisis Leaders of several major political parties in Balochistan have announced a province-wide shutdown strike on November 19, followed by demonstrations at all district headquarters, accusing the government of failing to address the province’s worsening political, security and economic crises, as reported by The Express Tribune.
ANI | Updated: 07-11-2026 17:38 IST | Created: 07-11-2026 17:38 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Leaders of several major political parties in Balochistan have announced a province-wide shutdown strike on November 19, followed by demonstrations at all district headquarters, accusing the government of failing to address the province’s worsening political, security and economic crises, as reported by The Express Tribune. According to The Express Tribune, the decision was taken at an all-parties conference organised by the Awami National Party (ANP) at the Quetta Press Club, chaired by ANP provincial president Asghar Khan Achakzai.
Participating parties agreed to turn their joint political and democratic struggle into a coordinated movement against what they described as growing public grievances. The leaders also announced a provincial-level meeting on November 26 to determine the next phase of their campaign.
An all-parties conference will subsequently be convened in the first week of December to present Balochistan’s pressing concerns before the national leadership. Representatives of the National Party, Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam, Pashtunkhwa National Awami Party and other political groups attended the gathering. In a joint declaration, the participating parties described the situation in Balochistan as alarming and unacceptable, highlighting persistent insecurity, terrorism, extremism, armed group activities, targeted killings and kidnappings for ransom.
They also raised concerns over the unresolved issue of missing persons, unemployment, economic deterioration and difficulties faced by transporters and passengers travelling on national highways. The declaration further blamed the closure of trade and transit routes with Afghanistan and Iran for severely disrupting economic activity across the province. Political leaders also highlighted the impact of soaring inflation, prolonged electricity and gas outages, petroleum levies and restrictions on essential agricultural supplies, including urea fertiliser, as cited by The Express Tribune.
They maintained that these measures have adversely affected agriculture, trade, industries and employment. The parties launched a strong attack on the provincial and federal governments, accusing them of failing to protect citizens, maintain law and order, safeguard natural resources and restore economic stability, as reported by The Express Tribune. (ANI)

WASHINGTON: The Trump administration warned a top Chinese official on Friday (Nov 6) that Beijing must immediately implement its commitments under a nearly year-old trade agreement, particularly on delivery of rare earths and other critical minerals and agricultural purchases, the United States Trade Representative's Office said.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer urged Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in a call to implement terms of the pact agreed in Busan, South Korea, in October 2025, the US agencies said.
"During the call, Ambassador Greer emphasized the critical importance of China taking concrete actions to fully implement its past commitments, particularly as they relate to agricultural purchases, rare earths and other critical minerals," USTR said in a statement.
During the call, China expressed "serious concern" over recent US trade restrictions targeting Beijing, China's official Xinhua news agency said.

But He, China's lead negotiator on trade relations with the US, agreed with his US counterparts to continue using consultation for "stable and positive" development of trade ties, Xinhua reported.
Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping are expected to meet at the summit of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen, China, on Nov 18 and 19, and the Group of 20 summit in Miami on Dec 14 and 15.
Greer said the Trump administration will pursue balanced trade with China by "monitoring compliance of past commitments while unlocking lasting benefits for American farmers, ranchers, manufacturers, and workers".
Greer, Bessent and other US officials have frequently complained about difficulties that US companies say they are experiencing in receiving sufficient quantities of rare earths and other critical minerals from China under the Busan agreement. The US says the deal was designed to lift restrictions put in place in 2025 during a period of tariff escalations between the world's two largest economies.
The Busan trade deal, which expires on Jan 10, capped US tariffs on Chinese goods implemented during Trump's second term at about 20 per cent. China has pledged to buy 25 million metric tons of US soybeans for the next three years and boost purchases of other American farm goods by US$17 billion.
"I emphasized the importance of China fully and immediately honouring its commitments, raised concerns about recent Chinese actions and underscored that progress depends on concrete results," Bessent said in a social media post.
The US will "closely assess China’s implementation of the arrangement", the Treasury said in a statement.
Beijing has signaled tariff concessions remain central to its aims, with its commerce ministry saying on Thursday that China was open to buying more US farm goods, but only if the two sides implement their reciprocal tariff-cut agreement.
Following a September summit between Xi and Trump in Washington, the two sides proposed a US$60 billion package of reciprocal tariff cuts, including roughly US$17 billion worth of US farm goods that China imported in 2024, though the plan has not been finalised.
The White House said in May that Beijing had agreed to buy US$17 billion of US agricultural goods annually from 2026, with this year's target adjusted on a prorated basis. Those purchases were in addition to a commitment made in October last year to buy US soybeans.

items.title: ケニアのカルト教団指導者に禁錮200年、子ども190人に餓死強要
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
(文中の余分な記号を削除しました)

［モンバサ（ケニア）　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
(文中の余分な記号を削除しました)

［モンバサ（ケニア）　６日　ロイター］ - ケニアの裁判所は６日、子ども１９０人を餓死させ森に埋めたとして、カルト教団指導者ポール・マッケンジー被告に禁錮２００年の判決を言い渡した。事件全体の犠牲者は５００人に上ると見られており、現代のカルト教団による大量殺人として最悪級の規模となった。

禁錮２００年の内訳は、餓死による殺人に１００年、直接的な殺害に１００年。

検察によると、マッケンジー被告はケニア東部インド洋沿岸近くの森林で、終末論を唱えるキリスト教系教団を率いていた。世界の終わりが来る前に天国に到達するため、子どもとともに餓死するよう信者に命じていた。

被告の共犯者は、命令に従うよう信者を脅したり、暴行を加えたりしていた。やせ細った遺体が各所の浅い墓から見つかったほか、便所に捨てられた遺体もあった。生き埋めにされた子どももいたという。

今回の裁判の対象となったのは子ども１９０人と成人１人の犠牲者だが、ケニア国家人権委員会によると、森林では最終的に４４８人の遺体が見つかった。マッケンジー被告は、３０キロ離れた村の別の場所で見つかった５２人の殺害を命じた罪にも問われており、これを合わせると犠牲者は計５００人に上る可能性がある。

Paraguay president ousted and placed under house arrest, successor sworn in

Santiago Peña was ousted from the presidency about an hour beforehand in a unanimous Senate vote, with lawmakers citing questions over his past links to the collapsed digital bank ueno that had provided accounts for nearly half of Paraguay's population.

ASUNCION, Paraguay: Pedro Alliana was sworn in as Paraguay's new president on Friday (Nov 6) just as authorities put his impeached predecessor Santiago Peña under house arrest, the latest developments in a fast-moving political and financial crisis triggered by the collapse of a digital bank.
Prosecutors speaking outside Peña's house in Asunción said charges were still being determined but could include influence peddling. Peña was ordered to appear at the prosecutor's office on Saturday morning.

Paraguay's Vice President Pedro Alliana is sworn in after President Santiago Pena was removed from office in an impeachment trial, in Asuncion, Paraguay, Nov 6, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Cesar Olmedo)

Peña was ousted from the presidency about an hour beforehand in a unanimous Senate vote, with lawmakers citing questions over his past links to the collapsed digital bank ueno that had provided accounts for nearly half of Paraguay's population.
Although Peña offered his resignation on Thursday, the Senate chose to finalise the impeachment process rather than accept, and swiftly moved to install his second-in-command, Alliana.

By the time of his arrest, dozens of protesters had gathered outside Peña's residence. Police installed a security cordon around the property.
The turmoil began earlier this week when Paraguay's central bank intervened in ueno, whose customers include many people who had not previously had access to a bank account.
The bank had grown rapidly since launching in 2021. But questions had emerged over ueno's lending practices and its ties to Paraguay's political and financial elite - including Peña, who until last year was a shareholder in ueno's holding company, and the central bank chief Carlos Carvallo, who had headed ueno until 2023.
Prosecutors on Friday also issued an arrest warrant for Carvallo, who resigned earlier this week as authorities launched last-ditch proceedings to prevent the lender dissolving. Eight former ueno executives have already been detained.
Others from Peña's inner circle also resigned, including his interior minister, chief of staff and two advisers.
The impeachment charges that led to his removal alleged that Peña had conflicts of interest, manipulated regulatory oversight, diverted pension funds and participated in an institutional cover-up involving the central bank.
Peña denied any wrongdoing and said the affair was a regulatory issue. The central bank has denied any conflict of interest, saying Carvallo recused himself from all decisions related to ueno.
FROZEN ACCESS TO FUNDS The political crisis has spilled onto the streets, with demonstrators flocking to downtown Asuncion demanding accountability for ueno's collapse and faster compensation for depositors whose savings remain frozen.
Small groups of protesters gathered opposite the headquarters of the central bank on Friday, chanting "We want our money."

People protest outside Congress during a session to discuss President Santiago Pena's resignation, days after Paraguay's central bank took over Ueno Bank amid a solvency crisis, in Asuncion, Paraguay, Thursday, Nov 5, 2026. (Photo: AP/Jorge Saenz)

Those who have been unable to access their accounts include pensioners who receive state benefits through ueno. Peña earlier this week approved legislation to help accelerate payments to affected depositors and some account holders began recovering their money on Thursday.
Prospects for a lengthy political transition have drawn attention from investors, especially in neighboring Brazil, Paraguay's largest economic partner. Regulators have sought to reassure markets by guaranteeing most deposits and containing risks to the wider financial system.
A Brazilian government source told Reuters that Brazil's immediate concern was avoiding social instability in Paraguay and ensuring the banking crisis is resolved without triggering wider unrest.
"Protests over frozen savings will intensify if Peña's exit appears to grant him impunity or if payouts to depositors and pensioners stall," said Mariano Machado, Americas principal analyst at Verisk Maplecroft.

Source: Reuters/cf

items.title: テニス＝ＷＴＡファイナル、練習の音声収録停止　選手の私的発言流出で
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - 女子テニス協会（ＷＴＡ）のバレリー・カミロ会長は６日、ＷＴＡファイナルの練習コートにおける音声録音機能を停止したと発表した。今週行われたライブ配信で選手の私的な発言が放送されてしまったことを受けた措置となる。

米カリフォルニア州インディアンウェルズで行われた練習セッションがＷＴＡのユーチューブチャンネルでライブ配信された際、ジェシカ・ペグラ（米国）とコーチの会話がマイクに拾われた。ペグラが、ロシア出身で今年の全仏オープン覇者であるミラ・アンドレエワを「ディーバ」と評し、「謙虚になる必要がある」などと述べた発言が交流サイト上で拡散された。

カミロ会長は録音に関する選手への掲示や事前通知が不十分だったことを認め、ＷＴＡファイナルでは練習コートでの音声録音は行わないとし、「周囲の音を拾おうとしたライブ配信が一定期間行われていたが、すでに修正されている。配信は削除された。大会期間中、練習コートでは今後、音声を録音しない」と記者団に語った。

ペグラは６日のメディア対応の場でこの件について質問されなかったが、米スポーツ専門局ＥＳＰＮに対し、「残念な事態」であるとコメント。選手のプライバシー保護の取り組みが推進されることを望んだ。

items.title: テニス＝アルカラスがマッチポイント2本しのぎ4強、マスターズ・パリ大会
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［パリ　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［パリ　６日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスのマスターズ・パリ大会は６日、シングルス準々決勝を行い、第２シードのカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）が第１１シードのテーラー・フリッツ（米国）に６─７、７─５、６─３で逆転勝ちし、初の４強入りを果たした。

アルカラスは第１セットで３本のセットポイントを逃し、タイブレークの末に先取された。第２セットも１─１から４本連続のブレークポイントをしのいだものの、その後にサービスゲームを落とし、３─４とリードを許した。その後、さらに２本のマッチポイントを握られる苦しい展開となったが、いずれもセーブして逆転。最終セットは序盤からリードを広げ、最初のマッチポイントで勝利を決めた。

フリッツはこの敗戦により１５日開幕のシーズン最終戦ＡＴＰファイナルへの出場を逃した。出場枠はラファエル・ホダル（スペイン）が獲得した。

第３シードのベン・シェルトンは第１２シードのトミー・ポールを６─４、４─６、６─３で下し、準決勝に進んだ。ポールは最終戦の出場権を逃し、フランシス・ティアフォー（いずれも米国）が出場を決めた。

そのほか、カスパー・ルード（ノルウェー）らが準決勝に進んだ。

items.title: サッカー＝アーセナルのサカ、負傷で数週間離脱へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、アーセナルのミケル・アルテタ監督は６日、太ももの筋肉を負傷したイングランド代表ＦＷブカヨ・サカ（２５）が数週間離脱する見通しを示した。

サカは先月行われた欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）のバイエルン・ミュンヘン（ドイツ）戦で大腿四頭筋を負傷。今月の欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）のクロアチア戦とスペイン戦も欠場する。

アルテタ監督は報道陣に対し、「（離脱は）数週間という話になる。代表戦による中断期間が終われば、練習を再開できるだろう。ただ、残念ながらしばらくは離脱することになる」と説明した。

一方、４日に行われたＣＬのスラビア・プラハ（チェコ）戦で膝に違和感を覚えて途中交代したＤＦエズリ・コンサについては、状態が改善していると明かした。

アーセナルはプレミアリーグで９試合を終えて勝ち点２４の首位。欧州ＣＬでもパリ・サンジェルマン（フランス）、レアル・マドリード（スペイン）と勝ち点２差の３位につけている。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャース、ベイツ打撃コーチが退団へ　新契約で合意に至らず
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）のドジャースがアーロン・ベイツ打撃コーチ（４２）と契約を更新せず、同コーチが退団する見通しとなった。複数の米メディアが６日に報じた。球団との新契約交渉で合意に至らなかったという。

ベイツ氏は２００６年のドラフト３巡目でレッドソックスに指名され、０９年にメジャーで５試合に出場。１４年を最後に現役を退いた後、１５年からドジャース傘下で指導者としてのキャリアを開始した。１９年にメジャーの打撃コーチ補佐に就任し、２３年から共同打撃コーチを務めていた。

ドジャースは２５年、２６年ともにシーズン後半に打線が低迷。今季はオールスター戦後の得点が２９５でメジャー１１位、本塁打も７７本で同１１位だった。

球団は２年連続でワールドシリーズを制した後、今季はナ・リーグ地区シリーズでブレーブスを破ったものの、リーグ優勝決定シリーズではブルワーズに４連敗を喫した。

一方、ドジャースは今季のナ・リーグ最優秀攻撃チームに贈られるシルバースラッガー賞の最終候補に選ばれている。１７日に受賞チームが発表される。

items.title: パラグアイでアリアナ新大統領就任、ペニャ前大統領は弾劾・自宅軟禁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
［アスンシオン　６日　ロイター］ - 南米パラグアイで６日、アリアナ新大統領が就任宣誓した。当局は弾劾で罷免されたペニャ前大統領を自宅軟禁下に置いた。デジタル銀行「ウエノバンク」が破綻し、同国の人口約６５０万人の半分弱に当たる約３００万人の預金者が銀行口座を利用できなくなったことで、ペニャ政権への抗議活動が広がっていた。

首都アスンシオンのペニャ氏の自宅前で取材に応じた検察当局者は、容疑の内容はなお精査中だが、影響力の不正行使が含まれる可能性があると述べた。
items.body:
［アスンシオン　６日　ロイター］ - 南米パラグアイで６日、アリアナ新大統領が就任宣誓した。当局は弾劾で罷免されたペニャ前大統領を自宅軟禁下に置いた。デジタル銀行「ウエノバンク」が破綻し、同国の人口約６５０万人の半分弱に当たる約３００万人の預金者が銀行口座を利用できなくなったことで、ペニャ政権への抗議活動が広がっていた。

首都アスンシオンのペニャ氏の自宅前で取材に応じた検察当局者は、容疑の内容はなお精査中だが、影響力の不正行使が含まれる可能性があると述べた。 ペニャ氏は７日午前に検察庁に出頭するよう命じられた。

下院は５日、臨時議会でペニャ氏の弾劾訴追案を可決。上院も６日、全会一致でペニャ氏の罷免を決定した。議員らは、破綻したデジタル銀行と同氏の過去の関係に疑義があると指摘した。

ペニャ氏は５日に辞意を表明したが、上院は辞任を受け入れるのではなく、弾劾手続きを完了させることを選択。速やかにアリアナ副大統領を後任に据えた。

アスンシオン中心部にはデモ参加者が押し寄せ、デジタル銀行破綻の責任追及や、凍結された預金の迅速な払い戻しを要求。「われわれの金を返せ」などと声を上げた。

items.title: Ｆ１＝ブラジルＧＰフリー走行、王者アントネッリがトップ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［サンパウロ　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［サンパウロ　６日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の今季第２０戦、ブラジル・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は６日、サンパウロでフリー走行２回を行い、メルセデスのキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア）がこの日のトップタイムを記録した。

アントネッリは２回目で最速１分１０秒７６３をマーク。０秒２５３差でマクラーレンのランド・ノリス（英国）が続いた。ノリスは１回目の最速１分１１秒７１７を記録していた。

３番手にアントネッリと０秒２５９差でレッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）が入った。メルセデスのジョージ・ラッセル（英国）が４番手、マクラーレンのオスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア）が５番手で続いた。

先週末のメキシコＧＰで３位に入って史上最年少で個人総合優勝を決めたアントネッリは「まだ取り組むべきことはあるが、全体的な感触は良いし、明日が楽しみ。良いチャンスがあると思う」と語った。

メルセデスはブラジルＧＰでフェラーリを３ポイント以上上回れば、コンストラクターズ部門のタイトルを確定することができる。

items.title: ゴルフ＝ＴＯＴＯジャパンクラシック、畑岡が単独首位に浮上
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - 女子ゴルフで日米の両ツアーを兼ねるＴＯＴＯジャパンクラシックは６日、茨城県の太平洋クラブ美野里（パー７２）で第２ラウンドを行い、昨年覇者の畑岡奈紗が６４をマークし、通算１２アンダーの１３２で単独首位に浮上した。

前日７位の畑岡は１イーグル、８バーディー、２ボギーの成績。１７番でイーグルを奪うなど後半９ホールを３０で回り、大会連覇に向けて好位置につけた。

首位で出た山下美夢有は６バーディー、１ボギーの６７で回り、通算１１アンダーの２位。前週の米ツアーで今季３勝目を挙げた山下は２週連続優勝を狙う。

菅楓華は通算１０アンダーの３位。原英莉花、佐久間朱莉、河本結、岩井明愛、高橋彩華が９アンダーの５位で続いた。

渋野日向子は７１で回り、通算３オーバーの７２位となった。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - 女子テニスのチェンナイ・オープンは６日、インドのチェンナイでシングルス準々決勝を行い、本玉真唯は逆転負けを喫し、４強入りを逃した。

第３シードのマグダ・リネッテ（ポーランド）と対戦した本玉は第１セットを６─４で先取したが、第２セットを５─７で落とすと、最終セットも４─６で取られた。

前回覇者で第１シードのジャニス・チェン（インドネシア）は第６シードのポリナ・クデルメトワ（ウズベキスタン）を５─７、６─４、６─２で下し、準決勝に進んだ。

items.title: サッカー＝板倉先発も退場、ボルシアＭＧ敗戦
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは６日、１試合を行い、日本人３選手が先発したボルシアＭＧは敵地でハンブルガーＳＶに１─３で敗れた。

板倉滉、宇野禅斗、町野修斗が先発したボルシアＭＧは前半１１分に先制を許したが、同４４分にジョー・スカリーが同点弾をマーク。しかし後半４分、板倉が抜け出した相手を引っ張り、この日２枚目のイエローカードを受けて退場した。

数的不利となったボルシアＭＧは、その後に２失点。チームは今季７敗目で、勝ち点４の最下位と苦しんでいる。宇野と町野はともに後半３６分までプレー、チームメートの橋岡大樹はメンバー外だった。

items.title: フィギュア＝三浦と千葉がＳＰで首位発進、ＧＰ中国杯
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第３戦、中国杯は６日、中国の深センで開幕し、男子ショートプログラム（ＳＰ）では三浦佳生が１０２．９０点、女子は千葉百音が７６．０８点でそれぞれ首位に立った。

三浦は冒頭の４回転サルコーと３回転トーループの連続ジャンプを決めると、トリプルアクセル（３回転半ジャンプ）、演技後半の４回転トーループも成功。ステップでは最高難度のレベル４を獲得した。

佐藤駿が１０１．９７点で２位につけ、日本勢が上位２位を占めた。佐藤は冒頭の４回転ルッツ、続く４回転トーループと３回転トーループの連続ジャンプを成功させ、後半のトリプルアクセルも決めた。

女子では千葉が冒頭の３回転フリップと３回転トーループの連続ジャンプを成功させ、演技後半の３回転ルッツでも加点を獲得。ステップと３種類のスピンはいずれもレベル４の評価を受けた。

items.body:
＜為替＞　ドル指数が急騰し、約５カ月ぶりの大幅な上昇率となる見通し。予想を上回る米雇用統計が、来月の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による利上げ観測を一段と強めた。    主要通貨に対するドルの価値を示すドル指数は０．７７％高の１０２．２６。ユーロは０．６７％安の１．１１４３７ドルに下落した。ドル指数は６月１７日以来の大幅な上昇率、ユーロは１０月１日以来の大幅な下落率となる勢い。    週間ではドルが０．３％高。ユーロは０．１％安となり、３週連続の下落に向かっている。    米労働省が６日発表した１０月の雇用統計によると、非農業部門雇用者数は前月比１６万５０００人増と、市場予想の６万５０００人増を大幅に上回った。失業率は４．１％と、９月の４．２％から低下した。nL6N46N0ZL    ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、１２月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げが実施されるとの市場の見方は、統計を受けて再び８０％近くに上昇した。    英ポンドは０．７１％安の１．３３５５ドルと、９月２３日以来の大幅な下落率となる勢い。イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が３年超ぶりの利上げに踏み切ったことを受け、５日に７週間超ぶりの高値を付けたが、この日は反落した。ポンドは週間で約０．３％安となった。    円は対ドルで０．４７％安の１５８．４３０円。円は週間で約０．６％安となり、週間下落率としては２％超下落した９月１８日終了週以来の大きさとなる。    日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、日銀は基調的なインフレ率が２％の物価安定目標付近で推移すると見込んでいるものの、一定の上振れリスクがあると認識していると述べた。nL6N46N17C 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　国債利回りが上昇した。１０月の雇用統計で雇用者数が予想を大きく上回って増加したことで、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１２月の会合で追加利上げに動くとの観測が強まった。    前日の取引では株価急落を受け、安全資産と見なされる国債に資金が流入し、利回りが低下。この日は前日の反動が見られた。    労働省が発表した１０月の雇用統計では、非農業部門雇用者数が前月比１６万５０００人増と、市場予想の６万５０００人増を大幅に上回った。失業率は４．１％と、９月の４．２％から低下。労働市場が夏場の失速から持ち直している可能性が示された。    ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、雇用統計発表を受け１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げが決定される確率は７５％と、発表前の７２％から上昇した。来年１月の会合での利上げ確率は８０％。    ＦＲＢは９月の会合で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを全会一致で決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来、３年２カ月ぶりだった。中間選挙の直前に開かれた１０月の会合では金利据え置きを決定したが、１２月の会合では利上げに踏み切るとの観測が高まっている。    終盤の取引で１０年債利回りは４．３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．８７８％。３０年債利回りは２．６ｂｐ上昇の５．２７７％。２年債利回りは５．１ｂｐ上昇の４．５２８％。    ２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は３３．７ｂｐ。前日の３７．１ｂｐから縮小し、イールドカーブはフラット化した。イールドカーブのフラット化は、追加利上げで短期金利が高止まりするとの見方を反映している。

ハイテク分野の上昇は幅広い銘柄に及んだ。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は４．２％上昇。エヌビディアは２．８％高、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）は１１％高 、サンディスクは約４％反発した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種のセクター別指数はまちまちで、情報技術が上昇を主導する一方、主要消費財とヘルスケアは軟調だった。エネルギーは週間ベースで１２％下落し、２０２５年４月以来最悪のパフォーマンスとなった。

一方、ソフトウエア企業アトラシアンは第１・四半期決算の発表を受けて１６％下落した。 

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞  米雇用統計が予想を上回ったことで、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が高金利政策を長期化させるとの見方が強まり、ドルと米長期金利が上昇したため、金相場は下落した。スポット金は０．３％安の１オンス＝４０７４．３６ドルとなり、取引時間中には１％超下落し４０３３．２９ドルまで値を下げた。１２月物の米金先物の清算値は０．９％安の４０７４．９０ドルだった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 米国時間の原油先物は、取引終盤に小幅上昇した。トランプ米大統領が、和平合意を目指すか、イランに残るものを破壊するかを近く決断すると述べ、米国による対イラン追加攻撃への懸念が再燃した。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物１月限が０．０３ドル（０．０３％）高の１バレル＝９８．３２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．３１ドル（０．３４％）高の９０．８３ドルだった。

items.title: ウクライナはロシア石油施設への攻撃継続、ロ軍の新たな攻撃に警戒＝ゼレンスキー氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Dan Peleschuk

[キーウ　６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Dan Peleschuk

[キーウ　６日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は６日、ロシアによるウクライナのエネルギー施設に対する攻撃への対抗措置として、ロシアの石油関連施設を標的とした攻撃を継続していると明らかにした。また、ロシア軍がウクライナの重要目標に対する新たな攻撃を計画していることが情報機関の分析で分かったとし、ウクライナ軍は厳しい任務に備えていると述べた。

ロシアとウクライナは和平実現に向け米国が仲介する３カ国の実務者協議を１０─１１日にアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビで再開する予定。協議開始を４日後に控える中でも双方の攻撃は続いている。

ゼレンスキー氏は「ロシアによるウクライナのエネルギー施設への攻撃に対する対応として、ロシアの石油精製部門に対する作戦を継続している」と通信アプリ「テレグラム」に投稿。ウクライナの発電所や送電網、暖房施設、水道システムがロシア軍の無人機やミサイルによる絶え間ない攻撃にさらされているとし、「ロシアは攻撃的な行動を変えておらず、われわれのパートナー諸国が提案した緊張緩和措置も拒否し、一段の攻撃を実施しようとしている」と記した。

ゼレンスキー氏はその後、恒例の夜のビデオ演説で「現時点で入手している情報によると、ロシアはエネルギー施設やドニエプル川に架かる橋のほか、民間インフラに対する新たな攻撃を準備している」とし、「空軍を含むウクライナ軍全体が防衛準備を進めている。容易な任務にはならない」と述べた。

その上で、ウクライナの都市防衛に必要な米国製地対空ミサイルシステム「パトリオット」向けミサイルの早期供与を改めて同盟国に要請していると語った。

首都キーウをはじめとするウクライナの各都市は数週間にわたりほぼ連日で攻撃を受けている。キーウでは市中心部を流れるドニエプル川に架かる主要な橋が攻撃を受け、交通網に混乱が生じているほか、停電の影響で地下鉄の運行が頻繁に停止。ゼレンスキー氏はキーウは国内で最も厳しいエネルギー事情に直面しているとし、キーウのクリチコ市長率いる市当局にも責任の一端があるとの考えを示した。クリチコ市長はこれに対し「首都を支援しない中央政府の行動は、事実上キーウを破壊している」と反論している。

ロシア当局は過去１週間に、石油産業関連施設への複数の攻撃があったと報告。中部サマラ州の施設が被害を受けたほか、モスクワ北東部のヤロスラブリや、首都南東部リャザンの工業施設にも攻撃があった。ウクライナはこれらの攻撃について具体的に関与を認めていない。

トランプ米大統領はこうした攻撃がディーゼル（軽油）価格上昇につながっているとの見方から、これまで複数回にわたり、ウクライナにロシアの石油精製施設への攻撃を停止するよう求めている。これに対しゼレンスキー氏は、ロシアがウクライナのエネルギー関連施設への攻撃を停止すれば、ウクライナもロシア国内の石油関連施設への攻撃を停止する用意があると述べている。

［ニューヨーク　６日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はナスダック総合が反発し、前日に付けた１９カ月ぶりの大幅安から持ち直した。だが、投資家が人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄の次の動きを見極めようとする中、週間ベースでは４週続落となった。

ハイテク分野の上昇は幅広い銘柄に及んだ。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は４．２％上昇。エヌビディアは２．８％高、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）は１１％高 、サンディスクは約４％反発した。

トルイスト・アドバイザリー・サービシズのキース・ラーナー最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は「人工知能（ＡＩ）がこの強気相場の支配的なテーマであることに変わりはないと今も考えている」とし、「ハイテク銘柄を引き続き前向きに評価している」と指摘。今週見られた売り浴びせは、多くの投資家にとってより長期的な買いの好機になる可能性が高いとの見方を示した。 

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種のセクター別指数はまちまちで、情報技術が上昇を主導する一方、主要消費財とヘルスケアは軟調だった。エネルギーは週間ベースで１２％下落し、２０２５年４月以来最悪のパフォーマンスとなった。 

その他の個別銘柄では、電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラは４．２％、宇宙関連企業スペースＸは８．６％、それぞれ上昇。民泊仲介大手エアビーアンドビーは１２％上昇。同社は５日、２０２６年通期の売上高成長率見通しを従来の「少なくとも１０％台半ば」から「１０％台後半」に上方修正した。 

一方、ソフトウエア企業アトラシアンは第１・四半期決算の発表を受けて１６％下落した。

Nov 6 : OpenAI has closed on new funding of $11 billion, the initial part of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion, a source familiar with the matter said on Friday.
The $11 billion raised so far represents only a portion of OpenAI's original target of up to $30 billion, while the company's valuation has come down from the $1.5 trillion level it had initially sought, two investors said.
SoftBank and MGX participated in the funding, the investors said.
Bloomberg News reported on the funding earlier on Friday.
Sentiment toward AI companies has cooled in the last month, with some investors valuing rival Anthropic's planned IPO at about $1.5 trillion, below earlier expectations of roughly $2 trillion.

［ニューヨーク　６日　ロイター］　 - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドル指数が急騰し、約５カ月ぶりの大幅な上昇率となる見通し。予想を上回る米雇用統計が、来月の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による利上げ観測を一段と強めた。

主要通貨に対するドルの価値を示すドル指数は０．７７％高の１０２．２６。ユーロは０．６７％安の１．１１４３７ドルに下落した。ドル指数は６月１７日以来の大幅な上昇率、ユーロは１０月１日以来の大幅な下落率となる勢い。

週間ではドルが０．３％高。ユーロは０．１％安となり、３週連続の下落に向かっている。

米労働省が６日発表した１０月の雇用統計によると、非農業部門雇用者数は前月比１６万５０００人増と、市場予想の６万５０００人増を大幅に上回った。失業率は４．１％と、９月の４．２％から低下した。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、１２月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げが実施されるとの市場の見方は、統計を受けて再び８０％近くに上昇した。

英ポンドは０．７１％安の１．３３５５ドルと、９月２３日以来の大幅な下落率となる勢い。イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が３年超ぶりの利上げに踏み切ったことを受け、５日に７週間超ぶりの高値を付けたが、この日は反落した。ポンドは週間で約０．３％安となった。

円は対ドルで０．４７％安の１５８．４３０円。円は週間で約０．６％安となり、週間下落率としては２％超下落した９月１８日終了週以来の大きさとなる。

日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、日銀は基調的なインフレ率が２％の物価安定目標付近で推移すると見込んでいるものの、一定の上振れリスクがあると認識していると述べた。

Nov 6 : Google has acquired Crusoe's data center site in southeast Wyoming, the AI infrastructure developer said on Friday, a day after the Alphabet unit announced a $17-billion investment in the project.
Here are some details:
• Google announced the investment on Thursday to build its first data center in Wyoming, expanding its AI infrastructure despite growing political opposition to such projects in parts of the US
• Crusoe said it has completed its involvement in the project's pre-development phase, which included site selection, government approvals and power strategy

• The deal's financial terms were not disclosed
• The campus was initially developed by Crusoe and Tallgrass Energy
• Google on Thursday said it would build the facility in partnership with Tallgrass Energy, as well as Black Hills Energy, American Electric Power and Related Digital
• Crusoe Chief Executive Chase Lochmiller said the company has more than 6 gigawatts of contracted capacity and over 40 gigawatts in its development pipeline
• Crusoe added that it is developing another Google data center campus in Armstrong, which it announced earlier this year

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

続落して取引を終えた。幅広い銘柄が売られた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間ベースで０．５２％安と反落。米中間選挙での民主党圧勝を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）を巡る懸念が強まり、リスク回避の姿勢が広がった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．８０％安、週間では０．２１％上昇した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種通信株指数は前日比３．５９％安。通信大手ＢＴグループは６．４％、エアテル・アフリカは４．０％、それぞれ下落した。

製薬・バイオテクノロジー株指数は０．５９％、生活必需品株指数は１．７０％、石油・ガス株指数は１．５７％いずれも下げた。

ヘッジファンド大手マン・グループは７．６％安。クウェートの年金基金との裁判で敗訴し、売り材料視された。

一方、貴金属株指数は１．６５％高だった。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

続落して取引を終えた。米中間選挙での民主党圧勝を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の先行きを巡る懸念が強まり、投資家にリスク回避の姿勢が広がった。ドイツのＤＡＸ指数は１．９２％下落。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは０．２４％上昇した。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種保険株指数は前日比２．６１％安。ＪＰモルガンがドイツの再保険会社の投資判断を引き下げたことを受け、ハノーバー再保険は４．４％、ミュンヘン再保険は４．３％、それぞれ下落した。

テクノロジー株指数は０．１６％安と続落。メディア株指数は２．２６％、個人・家庭用品株指数は１．８９％それぞれ下落した。オフィス支援業務を手がけるフランスのテレパフォーマンスは１５．３％安と急落した。通期売上高見通しを引き下げ、売られた。

一方、米イランの戦闘終結に向けた気運が高まり原油価格が低下するとの期待感から、旅行・娯楽関連株指数は０．８５％上昇。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

域内国債利回りがほぼ横ばいで推移した。ただ、米ハイテク株の急落を受けて投資家が安全資産に逃避し、市場で欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の利上げ観測が後退する中、週間ベースでは低下の見通しとなった。

ドイツ１０年債利回りは３．２５％と横ばい。一時、３．２０７５％と８月２６日以来の低水準を付けた。週間では７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の見通しとなった。 

フランス１０年債利回りは２ｂｐ低下。週間では２０ｂｐ低下の見通し。仏独１０年債利回り格差は１５２ｂｐと小幅に縮小した。

イタリア１０年債利回りは４．３４４％と横ばい。独伊１０年債利回り格差は１０８ｂｐとなった。

市場は、ＥＣＢの中銀預金金利が２０２７年終盤までに約３．０２％になると予想。１０月末の３．２５％から低下した。市場はまた、来月の理事会で約８０％の確率で利上げが実施されるとの見方を織り込んでいる。

イタリア１０年債利回りは４．３４４％と横ばい。独伊１０年債利回り格差は１０８ｂｐとなった。

市場は、ＥＣＢの中銀預金金利が２０２７年終盤までに約３．０２％になると予想。１０月末の３．２５％から低下した。市場はまた、来月の理事会で約８０％の確率で利上げが実施されるとの見方を織り込んでいる。

NEW YORK/LONDON, Nov 6 : Wall Street equities mostly rallied on Friday, reversing course after trillions of dollars of world stock market value were wiped out over fears that Democratic election victories this week would bring tighter US regulations for the AI industry.
The benchmark S&P 500 and the Nasdaq finished higher, with technology, communication services and industrials stocks driving gains. The Dow ended lower. All three indexes notched weekly losses following a brutal selloff in the prior session.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.46 per cent, the S&P 500 rose 0.31 per cent, and the Nasdaq Composite gained 1.1 per cent.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was up 4.2 per cent after slumping in its biggest one-day drop since April 2025. Nvidia rose nearly 3 per cent, after its worst day since January 2025, when the emergence of low-cost Chinese AI model DeepSeek hammered markets.

Other heavyweight chipmakers, including AMD, Intel, and Micron Technology, closed up between 5 per cent and 11 per cent, while Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX were also up 4 per cent and nearly 9 per cent respectively after losses earlier this week.
"Most of the disruption of the AI buildout will not probably occur but it's just the uncertainty of the change in government from Republican-led to Democratic-led, not only at the federal level but the state, local levels," said Gerry Sparrow, president and portfolio manager at Sparrow Capital Management.
"That's causing some disruption in the expectations of investors ... The volatility around elections or any political event, whether it be war or terrorist attack, is always going to disrupt the market."
Texas' Democratic Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa said on Thursday that the state — which already has a large share of US data centres — will introduce new laws to protect local communities from their further mass buildup.
The jitters are hitting an AI trade already under pressure from fears that the massive cost of the data centres and other infrastructure will limit future returns, spurring margin calls and spooking retail investors and hedge funds alike.
RIPPLE EFFECT
The bounces were in stark contrast with market action in the rest of the world. Europe's STOXX 600 lost 1 per cent. In Asia, Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's KOSPI both slumped about 6 per cent. For the Nikkei — just like Wall Street the previous day — it was the biggest one-day drop since US President Donald Trump's "Liberation Day" trade tariff panic of April 2025.
The MSCI All-World index fell 0.68 per cent while MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan lost nearly 3 per cent.
PAYROLLS BEAT FORECASTS
US nonfarm payrolls, usually one of the most-watched pieces of data, but largely overshadowed by the tech drama, showed a stronger-than-expected 165,000 pickup in jobs.
An anticipated slowdown in annual wage growth to below 3 per cent for the first time in nearly 5-1/2 years did not materialise either, as it came in at 3.1 per cent.
The yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note ticked up to 4.86 per cent, having dropped to its lowest level since September 9 overnight.
In currencies, the dollar rose against major currencies including the euro, yen and Swiss franc. It was up 0.52 per cent against the yen and rose 0.47 per cent against the Swiss franc. The euro was down 0.68 per cent against the dollar at $1.1142.
Brent crude prices settled at $98.32, rising just 0.03 per cent, on hopes the midterms' results might prompt Trump to de-escalate the Iran war.
Spot gold was flat at $4,066.28 per ounce.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 10月の世界平均気温、観測史上最高　通年は史上2番目か＝ＥＵ機関
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ブリュッセル ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ブリュッセル ６日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）の気象情報機関「コペルニクス気候変動サービス」は６日、１０月の世界平均気温が１５．３５度となり、観測史上最高だったと明らかにした。２０２６年通年の世界平均気温は産業革命前の水準を１．５度上回り、２４年に次いで観測史上２番目に高くなる可能性が高いとの見通しも示した。２４年と並ぶ、もしくは上回る可能性も約２０％あるという。

コペルニクス気候変動サービスは、「１０月の世界の平均地表気温は産業革命前の水準を１．７５度上回った」と指摘した。

両極圏を除く平均海面水温も２０．９５度となり、１０月としての観測史上最高を記録した。太平洋の赤道付近で海面水温が平年より高くなるエルニーニョ現象が強まっており、１０月まで３カ月連続で１．５度を上回り、２３─２６年までの４年間の平均もそれを超えると見込まれている。

１５年の国際枠組み「パリ協定」で、気温上昇を産業革命前の水準から１．５度以内に抑える目標を掲げる。科学者の間で、これを超える上昇は、深刻な熱波や干ばつ、洪水など、気候関連のリスクを急激に高めるとの指摘がある。

items.title: 米、中国にレアアース供給・農産物購入の約束履行要求
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Bhargav Acharya　David Lawder

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Bhargav Acharya　David Lawder

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権は６日、中国の何立峰副首相に対し、約１年前の貿易合意で約束した事項、特にレアアース（希土類）などの重要鉱物の供給と農産物購入について、直ちに履行するよう求めた。米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）が明らかにした。

米当局によると、ベセント米財務長官とグリアＵＳＴＲ代表は何氏との電話協議で、２０２５年１０月に韓国・釜山で結んだ合意の履行を促した。

ＵＳＴＲは声明で「グリア代表は協議で、中国が過去の約束、特に農産物購入やレアアースなどの重要鉱物に関する約束を完全に履行するため、具体的な行動を取ることが極めて重要だと強調した」と説明した。

中国国営新華社通信によると、中国側は協議で、最近の米国による対中貿易制限措置に「深刻な懸念」を表明した。ただ何氏は、貿易関係の「安定的かつ前向きな」発展に向け、引き続き協議を活用していくことで米側と合意したという。

トランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席は、１１月１８─１９日に中国・深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議と、１２月１４─１５日に米マイアミで開かれる２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）首脳会議に合わせて会談する見通し。

グリア氏は、トランプ政権が「過去の約束の履行状況を監視するとともに、米国の農家や牧場経営者、製造業者、労働者に持続的な利益をもたらす」ことで、中国との間で均衡の取れた貿易関係を目指すと述べた。

グリア氏やベセント氏ら米当局者は、米企業が釜山合意に基づいて中国から十分な量のレアアースなどの重要鉱物を受け取るのに苦労していると繰り返し訴えてきた。

２０２７年１月１０日に期限を迎える釜山合意は、トランプ氏の２期目に導入された中国製品への米関税の上限を約２０％とした。中国は今後３年間に米国産大豆２５００万トンを購入するほか、その他の米農産物の購入を１７０億ドル増やすと約束した。

ベセント氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で「中国が約束を完全かつ即時に履行することの重要性を強調し、最近の中国の行動に対する懸念を提起するとともに、進展は具体的な成果次第だと指摘した」と述べた。

items.title: 米追加利上げ必要の公算、高インフレ抑制へ＝ＳＦ連銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[６日 ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は６日、高すぎるインフレを抑制するため、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）はさらなる利上げが必要になる可能性が高いとの見方を示した。

デイリー氏はＣＮＢＣとのインタビューで「政策をさらに引き締める必要があると予想している」と述べた。ただ、具体的な時期や引き上げ幅についてはまだ明確ではないとした。

デイリー氏は、世界は多くの面で非常に不安定に見えるとの見方を示し、「そうした不安定要因は考慮に入れる必要がある」と指摘。その上で、「どこへ向かうべきかが正確に分からない状況では、より多くの情報を収集し、慎重かつ段階的に対応していく必要がある。しかし、さらなる措置が必要になる可能性は高く、経済がそれを求めるのであれば、われわれはそれを実行する用意がある」と述べた。

また、インフレ高止まりが続いている状況に言及し、インフレは最優先課題である必要があると指摘。この日発表の１０月の雇用統計が市場予想を大幅に上回ったことは「朗報」だとし、堅調な労働市場により、ＦＲＢはインフレ対策をやり遂げる余地が生まれているとの見解を示した。

さらに、投資家がＡＩ（人工知能）主導の需要拡大を巡るリスクを再評価する中、ハイテク株の価格は「痛み」を伴いながらも秩序立った形で再評価されていると指摘。その上で、ＡＩの価格再評価が需要鈍化の兆候を示しているのであれば、成長がやや減速する可能性があるとの見方を示した。

items.title: 米大統領首席補佐官にミラー氏、対移民強硬派
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Bo Erickson　Nandita Bose　Steve Holland　Trevor Hunnicutt

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Bo Erickson　Nandita Bose　Steve Holland　Trevor Hunnicutt

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は６日、長年の側近であるスティーブン・ミラー大統領次席補佐官（４１）を首席補佐官に昇格させる人事を発表した。共和党が上下両院で多数派の地位を失う中、トランプ氏は自らの最も強硬な国内政策の一部を立案してきたミラー氏に、米政権内で最も強い権限を持つポストの一つを委ねる。 

ミラー氏はスージー・ワイルズ氏（６９）の後任となる。女性として初めて大統領首席補佐官を務めたワイルズ氏は、トランプ氏の政治運営部門に異動する。

ミラー氏は長年、大統領の幅広い権限を支持してきた。３日の中間選挙で共和党が敗北し、トランプ氏が国内政策を推進する上で行政権限への依存を強める可能性がある中での就任となる。トランプ氏は、民主党が主導する上下院との対決や、自身の政権に対する一連の議会調査に備えている。 

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、ミラー氏を「最も信頼する顧問の一人」と表現。ワイルズ氏については、政治運営部門（Trump Political Operation）に異動するとし、「首席補佐官としての勤務に感謝したい。素晴らしい仕事をしてくれた」と投稿した。人事は９日付で発効する。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、ミラー氏の起用はトランプ氏に政策を見直す意向がなく、むしろ最も忠実な側近に報いていることを示していると語った。数千万人の米有権者がトランプ氏の国内政策と外交政策を拒否したにもかかわらず、「大統領は路線を変えるつもりはない」と同当局者は述べた。

トランプ氏は今週、議会の民主党と協力する用意があると述べた。ただ、複数のホワイトハウス当局者によると、辛辣で妥協しないことで知られるミラー氏の昇格は、トランプ氏がより対決的な姿勢を取り、移民などの政策を改めて推進する意向を示している可能性がある。

トランプ氏は自身の支持率が過去最低に近い水準に落ち込む中、３日の選挙を前に政治運営や広報体制に不満を抱いていた。事情の説明を受けた関係者によると、民主党が議会の主導権を奪還する中、トランプ氏は今週、ホワイトハウスは「より攻勢を強める」必要があると述べた。 

ミラー氏は指名後、Ｘに「使命はこれまで以上に明確だ。われわれの大統領を支え、この素晴らしい国を守るため、全身全霊で戦う」と投稿した。

下院議長に就任する見通しの民主党のハキーム・ジェフリーズ氏は、Ｘへの投稿でミラー氏を「無謀な過激主義者」と呼んだ。

ミラー氏はトランプ氏の最古参の側近の一人で、第１次、第２次両政権を通じて同氏を支えてきた数少ない人物でもある。

トランプ氏が２０２５年にホワイトハウスに復帰して以降、正式にはワイルズ氏の下で次席補佐官を務めてきたが、国内政策の広い範囲で肩書以上の影響力を振るい、大統領に直接意見を伝えられる立場にあった。

ミラー氏は、トランプ政権の強硬な移民取り締まりを主導し、１日３０００人逮捕という目標を掲げたことで特に知られる。

外交面では、カリブ海と太平洋で麻薬を運んでいる疑いのある船舶に対し、トランプ氏が実施してきた軍事攻撃を声高に支持。米国とイスラエルによるイランへの攻撃も称賛し、イラン政府を弱体化させ、近隣諸国を脅かす能力を抑える手段として海上封鎖と制裁を擁護してきた。

CHICAGO, Nov 6 : The US Department of Agriculture will use an artificial intelligence tool it built to check data in next week's monthly crop production report, agency officials said, after a series of data missteps eroded farmers' and traders' trust in its forecasts.
After the USDA discovered errors in its corn data from September, officials determined the AI tool would have flagged the problem and decided to use it on the crop production report due on November 10, USDA Under Secretary Scott Hutchins said in an interview.
The tool's debut tests whether the agency can restore confidence in data that often moves markets. 
"I'm very bullish on the fact that we'll be able to utilize these tools in the future to help us avoid these kinds of really, truly unfortunate errors," Hutchins said on Thursday.

Last month, the USDA corrected its September corn production and yield data. The correction raised the yield estimate by about 3 per cent in Nebraska, the third-biggest corn-producing state, and lowered it by about 2 per cent in Kansas. 
The agency, long viewed as the gold standard of global agricultural market information, previously faced criticism after it made sharp upward revisions to estimates for last year's corn acreage. Over the summer, it  reported inaccurate beef export sales data.
The USDA previously said it was launching a pilot project that would rely more heavily on technology to improve crop acreage and yield estimates as fewer farmers respond to its surveys. 
COMPUTER FILE ERROR 
Lance Honig, chair of the agricultural statistics board for USDA's National Agricultural Statistics Service, told Reuters that a computer file incorrectly combined data on irrigated and non-irrigated corn acres gathered by field surveyors, causing the errors in September's data. Kansas and Nebraska were affected because they have higher percentages of irrigated fields, which often have higher yields, he said. 
"This error that occurred in September is literally a very isolated occurrence that, quite frankly, with the proper validation, we should have caught," Honig said. "There was no issue with the data that was gathered at the field level."
The errors angered farmers who are struggling to make money as they pay soaring prices for diesel, fertilizer and other inputs. Last month, the National Corn Growers Association, which represents 35,000 farmers, said the September errors were unacceptable and had further hurt farmers' confidence in the USDA's ability to produce accurate reports.
"You just don't know what the USDA is going to do anymore," said Jim Gerlach, president of brokerage A/C Trading in Indiana, on Friday. "Their reports have become so erratic."
Questions around the credibility of federal data increased after President Donald Trump's administration sharply downsized the government last year. Thousands of employees at the USDA have left, and experts have worried the cuts hobbled the agency's ability to produce accurate and timely data.
Hutchins said the September errors were not related to staffing losses. The new AI tool will add to, not replace, the agency's data validation, he said. 
"The tool is basically going to be used as a check to make sure that there are no anomalies that we were not able to see or identify in the normal process," Hutchins said.      
This week, market analysts questioned the accuracy of another monthly USDA report on soy processing which showed a sharp divide between how many soybeans were crushed and how much soymeal was produced in Iowa.  The USDA said it was reviewing the report as part of a normal process and would make any necessary revisions next month. 

Source: Reuters

Nov 6 : OpenAI will press ahead with its US data-center expansion plans despite a Democratic midterm sweep this week that has fueled fears of tighter scrutiny of the facilities, its Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar told CNBC in an interview on Friday.
"When I think about the midterms, I need to keep thinking about how do we keep investing to meet customer demand," Friar said. "We are going to keep building out those relationships with communities so we can get the compute we need," she added. 
One of the corporate faces of the AI boom, OpenAI has moved quickly to counter fears that a shift in congressional power could slow the industry's growth. It launched a charm offensive on Thursday to win over communities as opposition to data centers becomes a rallying point for anxieties about the technology.
As part of the efforts, OpenAI said, it will no longer use non-disclosure agreements with public officials when negotiating or discussing future sites. It will also give residents access to construction plans and their potential effects.
